26838ca7-418a-47d2-8429-7339ebbb8993.name: Omnisky III Cannon
26838ca7-418a-47d2-8429-7339ebbb8993.desc: The Omnisky III is the base model in A&R's line of laser autocannons for small ships and has a comparable rate of fire, damage output and range to other weapons in its size class. It uses mid-grade components in its design, offering a marked increase in power efficiency over some of its less expensive competitors.

1893e596-acaf-49bc-b367-e43e99c2925f.name: Omnisky VI Cannon
1893e596-acaf-49bc-b367-e43e99c2925f.desc: The Omnisky VI is the mid-sized laser autocannon from manufacturer A&R. It boasts increased damage and range and power consumption over its smaller brother, the Omnisky III, and utilizes many of the same components resulting in middle-of-the-road power efficiency.

95c85f25-ccd9-402e-b02a-522f5a97a654.name: Omnisky IX Cannon
95c85f25-ccd9-402e-b02a-522f5a97a654.desc: The Omnisky IX is the size three version of Amon & Reese's popular laser autocannon. The weapon's low rate of fire is offset by its effective range, which allows it to deliver a powerful shot from afar.

cf57c4df-0fed-40bb-9771-10fc7853d8f9.name: Omnisky XII Cannon
cf57c4df-0fed-40bb-9771-10fc7853d8f9.desc: Amon & Reese's dependable line of laser autocannons continues with the Omnisky XII. Though slow firing, this size four laser is able to efficiently deliver devastating laser beam blasts from a considerable range.

c778d7c0-116a-4597-a32e-2bbf7f6b7c17.name: Omnisky XV Cannon
c778d7c0-116a-4597-a32e-2bbf7f6b7c17.desc: Amon & Reese's reputation for making powerful and reliable weapons is embodied by their Omnisky line of laser autocannons. The Omnisky XV is the size five version of the weapon that's helped defend the Empire for centuries.

1901415b-cfbd-49fb-82f8-42eff2c11f01.name: Omnisky XVIII Cannon
1901415b-cfbd-49fb-82f8-42eff2c11f01.desc: Nicknamed 'Augustus' by Amon & Reese engineers after the Roman Emperor who founded the notable 'Eighteenth Legion,' this massive size six laser autocannon hits hard over great distances, making the Omnisky XVIII an effective way to keep enemies at bay.

aa41e4d8-6b99-4f63-90d5-b0956e70c1d8.name: PyroBurst Scattergun
aa41e4d8-6b99-4f63-90d5-b0956e70c1d8.desc: You ship will spread havoc with A&R’s PyroBurst plasma shotgun. Effective in close quarters, the PyroBurst sprays self-detonating plasma projectiles, sacrificing pinpoint accuracy for area saturation.

df89e9ca-8a11-477c-8abd-f4837a277dbe.name: Revenant Gatling
df89e9ca-8a11-477c-8abd-f4837a277dbe.desc: If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. And if you want it broke, aim a Revenant at it. Solidly built on a foundation of centuries-old tech, Apocalypse Arms puts an innovative spin on battle-tested designs to create a rugged ballistic Gatling that can steadily hurtle death across the void. Though it’s slow to spin up and cool down, the Revenant’s dependability makes it a favorite for those expecting to find trouble.

85726664-e16d-4a24-98f8-7cc8f0ba6f00.name: Draugar Gatling
85726664-e16d-4a24-98f8-7cc8f0ba6f00.desc: Reminiscent of a bygone era of space combat, this brutal size six ballistic Gatling from Apocalypse Arms is a very deliberate weapon. Take a moment as the Draugar's drum spins up to speed to savor the ruin and destruction that you are about unleash.

2ef5eb91-95ec-442c-a856-79a39f84d365.name: Havoc Scattergun
2ef5eb91-95ec-442c-a856-79a39f84d365.desc: Sow dread across the battlefield with the Havoc from Apocalypse Arms. This size one scattergun deals massive damage at close range, making it the perfect weapon for finishing a fight.

c7c36fea-dcf5-48b9-9939-bf2771f9f8f4.name: Hellion Scattergun
c7c36fea-dcf5-48b9-9939-bf2771f9f8f4.desc: Apocalypse Arms' Hellion is a size two scattergun that saturates targets with ballistic ammo in close quarters. The gun's smart ammo functionality allows it to switch between standard and specialty rounds.

fac5a97f-64bf-450e-a2f2-90e4da5ccf73.name: Predator Scattergun
fac5a97f-64bf-450e-a2f2-90e4da5ccf73.desc: The Predator scattergun preys upon nearby opponents with an overwhelming barrage of ballistic ammo. The size three version of Apocalypse Arms' feared scattergun trades effective range for a wide spread.

86630fcf-09c3-4def-a7b4-9385cbc05a42.name: Strife Mass Driver Cannon
86630fcf-09c3-4def-a7b4-9385cbc05a42.desc: It always pays to be prepared, and if misfortune ever does strike, you’re going to be glad you have an Apocalypse Arms Strife Mass Driver handy. Its electromagnetic accelerators may be a little power hungry, but it makes up for it with how rapidly it can fire its high velocity projectiles. Watching it tear through your target is enough to make any bad day a little bit better. Just be careful not to let it overheat.

34bc9924-3f20-4bc9-a6cf-81335a0608fe.name: DR Model-XJ1 Repeater
34bc9924-3f20-4bc9-a6cf-81335a0608fe.desc: Power is the life blood of every ship, and the DR Model-XJ1 from ASD is the ideal choice to bleed hostiles dry. This cutting-edge distortion repeater allows you to disrupt power on targets, disabling threats efficiently.

a5ade53b-9c40-477a-aaf8-78b6ef485283.name: DR Model-XJ2 Repeater
a5ade53b-9c40-477a-aaf8-78b6ef485283.desc: Advancing the field of distortion weapons, the DR Model-XJ2 repeater from ASD provides tactical energy disruption that will severely limit any targeted ships operational capacity.

2a787ee5-d720-4490-8823-65a0f8578f4b.name: DR Model-XJ3 Repeater
2a787ee5-d720-4490-8823-65a0f8578f4b.desc: Shutdown hostile actions and target power supplies with the DR Model-XJ3, a well-ranged distortion repeater developed by the advanced weapons research labs of ASD.

e0c51f49-8910-4c99-92e5-ba7eca915bbb.name: Singe Cannon (S1)
e0c51f49-8910-4c99-92e5-ba7eca915bbb.desc: Made popular by a Banu souli, the Singe tachyon cannon consistently delivers devastating energy damage across vast distances. Though slow to fire, the lightning-fast tachyon projectile strikes targets almost instantaneously, making the Singe a favorite choice for Banu security ships. Although the Banu have long forgotten the origin of this high tech weapon, several unique design choices have led scholars to suspect that the Banu might have appropriated the tech into their culture, instead of inventing it themselves.

40b94722-48be-406a-9843-5c77772e4ab4.name: Singe Cannon (S2)
40b94722-48be-406a-9843-5c77772e4ab4.desc: Made popular by a Banu souli, the Singe tachyon cannon consistently delivers devastating energy damage across vast distances. 6635dc5f-dfcd-4b72-9d9d-8d3620820352.desc: Hurtling high caliber rounds with devastating velocity, Behring’s C-788 Ballistic Autocannon was built to punch through ship armor. Extremely durable with exceptional heat resistance, the “Combine” can handle a heavy workload that, even with the weapon’s slower rate of fire, makes it an ideal choice for taking on larger, less maneuverable targets.

1c5cb632-fe64-42a4-9a4e-86147a4dcd74.name: Conqueror-7
1c5cb632-fe64-42a4-9a4e-86147a4dcd74.desc: Bring your conquest to the skies using Hurston Dynamics' Conqueror-7 ballistic cannon. Bespoke built for the Aegis Idris dorsal turret, these cannons are able to engage larger ships from a distance, finishing fights before they even begin.

abc07204-f051-4b33-ab6e-9b98305353db.name: C-07T Cannon
abc07204-f051-4b33-ab6e-9b98305353db.desc: A dedicated anti-capital ship weapon adjusted to meet the combat demands of the Tiburon, the C-07T Ballistic Cannon delivers overwhelming offensive power, proving Behring continues to innovate in all areas of battlefield technology.

8115a034-92bf-4766-b0ce-408398ddc7e7.name: CVSA Cannon
8115a034-92bf-4766-b0ce-408398ddc7e7.desc: Behring designed the CVSA to be their Vanguard only ballistic cannon variant. This weapon features a slower rate of fire delivers a higher velocity round that is ideal for dealing major damage to targets at medium to long ranges.

cfbd1437-b6aa-480a-b3a2-5d3ad001c726.name: TMSB-5 Gatling
cfbd1437-b6aa-480a-b3a2-5d3ad001c726.desc: These twin ballistic gatling was designed in conjunction with Anvil Aerospace for use on the F7C Hornet Mk II and are intended to be gimbal mounted onto a ball turret for adaptive targeting.

647c70b5-1547-4c86-ba47-4aa452d3b506.name: MRX "Torrent"
647c70b5-1547-4c86-ba47-4aa452d3b506.desc: The latest generation of point-defense technology, the MRX "Torrent" utilizes advanced search, detection, and tracking software to unleash a swift barrage of ballistic fire, protecting ships from incoming missiles, torpedoes, and other high-speed threats.

e4afc8b4-da61-4efb-af7e-f003d9900d96.name: AD4B Ballistic Gatling
e4afc8b4-da61-4efb-af7e-f003d9900d96.desc: The AD4B, Behring's take on the classic ballistic gatling, includes a crystal cycle firing mechanism in the the high speed rotary system to maximize efficiency for sustained engagements with minimal misfires. Next time an aggressor escalates a hostile situation, make them regret the decision by spinning up this overwhelming and effective weapon.

f52975b5-d621-4c08-9dcc-3c4bd8170383.name: AD5B Ballistic Gatling
f52975b5-d621-4c08-9dcc-3c4bd8170383.desc: The AD5B, Behring's take on the classic ballistic gatling, includes a crystal cycle firing mechanism in the the high speed rotary system to maximize efficiency for sustained engagements with minimal misfires. 6c46b8e3-81c8-4018-bce2-740b81174a00.name: AD6B Ballistic Gatling
6c46b8e3-81c8-4018-bce2-740b81174a00.desc: The AD6B, Behring's take on the classic ballistic gatling, includes a crystal cycle firing mechanism in the the high speed rotary system to maximize efficiency for sustained engagements with minimal misfires. Next time an aggressor escalates a hostile situation, make them regret the decision by spinning up this overwhelming and effective weapon.

51264411-1e57-48b9-b1d8-6fab4fb3a687.name: SF7B Gatling
51264411-1e57-48b9-b1d8-6fab4fb3a687.desc: Slug it out with large spacecraft and swiftly shred smaller ships with the SF7B ballistic Gatling. Built specifically for the Ares Inferno Star Fighter, the weapon seamlessly integrates into the body of the ship. The weapon's impressive rate of fire unleashes high-density rounds that tear through armor and shields, making it a perfect choice for situations where target saturation is key.

631884a6-7e06-4612-986c-1b3e556aecac.name: SW16BR1 “Buzzsaw” Repeater
631884a6-7e06-4612-986c-1b3e556aecac.desc: Firing from two barrels, the SW16BR1 "Buzzsaw" can overwhelm aggressors at medium to close range. Behring's expert craftsmanship allows the weapon to engage in sustained firefights before needing a cooldown, making it an excellent entry level ballistic repeater.

d4ebab35-1d86-4259-82dc-cda6a7167c90.name: SW16BR2 “Sawbuck” Repeater
d4ebab35-1d86-4259-82dc-cda6a7167c90.desc: The SW16BR2 Sawbuck is Behring’s contribution to the expanding Ballistic Repeater market. Its sequential-firing double barrel configuration offers an effective middle-ground for operators looking for a higher rate of fire than a cannon, but without the fear of overheating that you would get with a gatling.

bbfbb4b5-c26e-4bee-9d41-9679e102e860.name: SW16BR3 “Shredder” Repeater
bbfbb4b5-c26e-4bee-9d41-9679e102e860.desc: Blast your way out of trouble with this Behring size three ballistic repeater. The SW16BR3 "Shredder" distributes heat across both barrels to keep it firing when needed most. The weapon's shot grouping and damage falloff make it most deadly at medium or close range.

a4f4afa6-aa15-46e4-9327-c27250c3ea83.name: BRVS Repeater
a4f4afa6-aa15-46e4-9327-c27250c3ea83.desc: Only Vanguard owners can equip this unique version of Behring's line of ballistic repeaters to the nose of their ship. The BRVS is carefully calibrated so its ballistic barrage would fire fast enough to provide maximum target saturation while its improved venting reduces frequent overheating.

f8c20ae0-b9c7-4c1b-9488-27d1639fb06f.name: EVSD Cannon
f8c20ae0-b9c7-4c1b-9488-27d1639fb06f.desc: Disable ships without hurting their crew or cargo with the EVSD from Behring. This distortion cannon features much of the same industry-leading technology used in other Behring weapons, but is specifically designed to be mounted on the nose of an Aegis Vanguard.

d60d2103-fdc4-446e-8a3b-0af114f2e23e.name: ATVS Repeater
d60d2103-fdc4-446e-8a3b-0af114f2e23e.desc: Mess with an aggressor's electrical system with the ATVS from Behring. This disruptive, non-lethal distortion repeater is only compatible with the nose-mount on the Aegis Vanguard.

42e2ddb1-7397-4299-88ee-2ddfaa0efc67.name: M3A Cannon
42e2ddb1-7397-4299-88ee-2ddfaa0efc67.desc: The M3A is Behring's entry level laser autocannon. The autocannon configuration offers modest damage per projectile and a fairly low rate of fire. As the most basic offering in Behring's weapons lineup, it features low power consumption, but poor power efficiency. It makes up ground for its shortcomings by being cheap, a feature many pilots are looking for when outfitting their ships on a budget.

36db47ca-d33b-484e-a2cc-fdf51b7bd549.name: M3A Cannon Raider Camo
36db47ca-d33b-484e-a2cc-fdf51b7bd549.desc: The M3A is Behring's entry level laser autocannon. The autocannon configuration offers modest damage per projectile and a fairly low rate of fire. As the most basic offering in Behring's weapons lineup, it features low power consumption, but poor power efficiency. It makes up ground for its shortcomings by being cheap, a feature many pilots are looking for when outfitting their ships on a budget.\n\nThe Raider Camo edition is a combination of dark greens and browns.

2756f5f1-ef1e-454a-a171-9a5bd40e3a9d.name: M4A Cannon
2756f5f1-ef1e-454a-a171-9a5bd40e3a9d.desc: The M4A is Behring's second tier laser autocannon. Its bigger size means more power consumption in exchange for packing a bigger punch. Fire rate and power efficiency are comparable to the M3A model.

b0ff21c6-312f-4196-88fb-c24d883ca003.name: M4A Cannon Raider Camo
b0ff21c6-312f-4196-88fb-c24d883ca003.desc: The M4A is Behring's second tier laser autocannon. Its bigger size means more power consumption in exchange for packing a bigger punch. Fire rate and power efficiency are comparable to the M3A model.\n\nThe Raider Camo edition is a combination of dark greens and browns.

f72ca643-b48c-4f6e-abb7-d5bc8eb261aa.name: M5A Cannon
f72ca643-b48c-4f6e-abb7-d5bc8eb261aa.desc: When energy autocannons are designed, Behring's M5A provides the standard to which they are measured against, owing to its long range of engagement and low damage fallout.

9fd5d7b0-0a54-40b5-a36e-dca802cd3aaa.name: M5A Cannon Raider Camo
9fd5d7b0-0a54-40b5-a36e-dca802cd3aaa.desc: When energy autocannons are designed, Behring's M5A provides the standard to which they are measured against, owing to its long range of engagement and low damage fallout.\n\nThe Raider Camo edition is a combination of dark greens and browns.

52c1793e-5610-4daa-aafe-a8cf55e60283.name: M6A Cannon
52c1793e-5610-4daa-aafe-a8cf55e60283.desc: Behring's M6A is a versatile high velocity energy autocannon, designed to provide to keep your enemy at range without sacrificing your stopping power.

b94c54b2-a70e-4f41-bc02-ed76be87e493.name: M7A Cannon
b94c54b2-a70e-4f41-bc02-ed76be87e493.desc: This versatile long distance energy autocannon is the latest in Behring’s M-Series. The M7A is designed to act as a high impact deterrent effective at medium to long range. The new AC8 Lens system minimizes stopping power loss over distance, making each shot equally effective at longer ranges.

4e3897c1-a48f-4dce-b3cf-0f91fe3eb0f6.name: M8A Cannon
4e3897c1-a48f-4dce-b3cf-0f91fe3eb0f6.desc: The M8A laser autocannon exemplifies Behring's extensive history designing and constructing ship armaments. The result is a dependable and effective energy weapon capable of handling large skirmishes or precise defensive maneuvers.

af019617-94ee-4a91-b62b-124c93f2a45e.name: M9A Cannon
af019617-94ee-4a91-b62b-124c93f2a45e.desc: Strike at the very heart of your enemies with the devastating impact of Behring's M9A energy autocannon. When fully charged, the massive stopping power of this laser weapon has the potential to halt even capital ships in their tracks.

6bf837a5-2763-4cd3-aa9c-869b0e798cb3.name: M10A Cannon
6bf837a5-2763-4cd3-aa9c-869b0e798cb3.desc: Strike at the very heart of your enemies with the devastating impact of Behring's M9A energy autocannon. When fully charged, the massive stopping power of this laser weapon has the potential to halt even capital ships in their tracks.

bf958f42-4f50-46ce-af92-64b08e7f7c19.desc: Strike at the very heart of your enemies with the devastating impact of Behring's M9A energy autocannon. When fully charged, the massive stopping power of this laser weapon has the potential to halt even capital ships in their tracks.

25ebe37d-5fdd-4319-ad41-71d768b5bed4.name: SF7E Cannon
25ebe37d-5fdd-4319-ad41-71d768b5bed4.desc: Engineers from Behring and Crusader collaborated to make the SF7E laser cannon the ideal weapon for the Ares Ion Star Fighter. A custom shell allows the massive weapon to seamlessly integrate into the body of the ship. Ideal for long-range engagements involving large and capital-class spacecraft, the SF7E's impressive accuracy and high damage-per-round make it a devastating weapon in the hands of a skilled shooter.

febc4b3a-09d7-446e-99a4-0f6be2387346.name: MVSA Cannon
febc4b3a-09d7-446e-99a4-0f6be2387346.desc: The classic M4A has been specially retooled by Behring to create the VS (Vanguard Special), a laser weapon designed to meet the Aegis' unique requirements. The default nose-mounted weapon on the Vanguard Warden, the MVSA can only be loaded onto other Vanguard variants.

18b795c5-25f1-444a-86c0-b5edd7cf0118.name: M2C "Swarm"
18b795c5-25f1-444a-86c0-b5edd7cf0118.desc: The latest generation of point-defense technology, the M2C "Swarm" utilizes advanced search, detection, and tracking software to unleash a swift barrage of laserfire, protecting ships from incoming missiles, torpedoes, and other high-speed threats.

2f68375a-3c66-4e02-9d1f-5d7f37c12725.name: GVSR Repeater
2f68375a-3c66-4e02-9d1f-5d7f37c12725.desc: Aegis commissioned Behring to design a laser repeater specifically for their Vanguard line-up. The result was the GVSR, which met Aegis exacting standards by delivering a steady rate of fire without overtaxing the ship's power plant.

56c36bd9-9090-4166-a3dd-9dc8ad225f70.name: NV57 Ballistic Gatling
56c36bd9-9090-4166-a3dd-9dc8ad225f70.desc: Break the ranks with the NV57 Ballistic Gatling Gun designed to replace the standard Tumbril Nova tank canon. Be ready to face overwhelming ground forces head on using this high powered weapon with superior damage output and a devastating rate of fire.

3727a5ce-bf98-43a7-a96e-c0ffedd071d0.name: Deadbolt I Cannon
3727a5ce-bf98-43a7-a96e-c0ffedd071d0.desc: Spread dread with the Deadbolt I ballistic cannon. Esperia has painstakingly recreated the Deadbolt I out of respect to the original weapon and warriors who used it so effectively.

a336be9a-ea2f-4db2-97ec-593ad6134471.desc: The Lightstrike VI takes the attack to distant targets by delivering focused, high damage blasts that will make any aggressor think twice before coming too close. Capable of providing powerful overwatch options during troop deployments or engaging targets in outer space, it's easy to see why the Lightstrike VI was feared by UPE forces during the First Tevarin War.

8bebf292-a9a3-4dc8-a86c-ddfa3b9b79be.name: Tarantula GT-870 Mark 1 Cannon
8bebf292-a9a3-4dc8-a86c-ddfa3b9b79be.desc: Fed by Gallenson Tactical’s patented SpinGlide drum ammunition system, the Tarantula GT-870 Mk1 can smoothly and accurately deliver a consistent stream of ballistic shells. Though it only has a moderate rate of fire, its trustworthy durability makes it a dependable addition to any fight.

972c562f-bc9b-441c-a2fb-785293e54eda.name: Tarantula GT-870 Mark 2 Cannon
972c562f-bc9b-441c-a2fb-785293e54eda.desc: Fed by Gallenson Tactical’s patented SpinGlide drum ammunition system, the Tarantula GT-870 Mk2 can smoothly and accurately deliver a consistent stream of ballistic shells. Though it only has a moderate rate of fire, its trustworthy durability makes it a dependable addition to any fight.

0c60b4ec-ba9c-42e5-9246-6f241f138167.name: Tarantula GT-870 Mark 3 Cannon
0c60b4ec-ba9c-42e5-9246-6f241f138167.desc: Fed by Gallenson Tactical’s patented SpinGlide drum ammunition system, the Tarantula GT-870 Mk3 can smoothly and accurately deliver a consistent stream of ballistic shells. Though it only has a moderate rate of fire, its trustworthy durability makes it a dependable addition to any fight.

81645f3b-2c01-4fc4-aa9f-ed860b976058.name: YellowJacket GT-210 Gatling
81645f3b-2c01-4fc4-aa9f-ed860b976058.desc: While the GT-210 YellowJacket may be small, it packs a mighty sting. This high-speed ballistic weapon is perfect for targeting smaller, more mobile targets and its DTX-8 ammo supply system almost completely eliminates weapon jams due to bad rounds.

7034e330-3d22-4e89-83cb-c01815dbb875.name: Scorpion GT-215 Gatling
7034e330-3d22-4e89-83cb-c01815dbb875.desc: The Scorpion GT-215 is a hydraulically-driven Gatling-type rotary cannon designed to deliver smaller rounds at a very high rate of fire. The Scorpion is designed to shred armor on very fast targets, sacrificing power for absolute saturation of the target area.

b837397c-47b6-45e7-b409-db290a068b47.name: Mantis GT-220 Gatling
b837397c-47b6-45e7-b409-db290a068b47.desc: The Mantis GT-220 is a hydraulically-driven Gatling-type rotary cannon designed to deliver smaller rounds at a very high rate of fire. The Mantis is designed to shred armor on very fast targets, sacrificing power for absolute saturation of the target area.

bbd36fbd-6e56-49b1-aae6-9df8b36b4092.name: Deathroll S2 Gatling
bbd36fbd-6e56-49b1-aae6-9df8b36b4092.desc: Created from a mixture of different parts, the Deathroll gatling gun can rapidly fire across a long range. Though it requires ammunition, the explosive power each shot contains more than makes up for the cost of ammo.

353a4aae-1fb1-470c-a38c-2ca32e61bb12.name: Breakneck S4 Gatling
353a4aae-1fb1-470c-a38c-2ca32e61bb12.desc: While the exact origins and designer are unknown, the Breakneck is built off an existing ballistic gatling then modified to cause more mayhem. When the Breakneck starts shooting, the fun begins.

06615bad-8050-4758-ab2d-c79ad80307ed.name: Snapper S2 Repeater
06615bad-8050-4758-ab2d-c79ad80307ed.desc: With its rapid rate of fire and high-intensity heat per blast, the Snapper laser repeater builds on the standards of its kind and improves on them with its combination of components from a range of other guns.

87d981fb-e1f3-40ad-ad6f-2f7a7a8f665e.name: Tormenter S3 Repeater
87d981fb-e1f3-40ad-ad6f-2f7a7a8f665e.desc: Scorch and torch those who dare get in your way with the Tormenter. Overhauled from an existing laser repeater, the Tormenter can somehow unleash an absolute firestorm without melting the weapon's barrel.

9fd3b3be-5653-413f-ba8f-0959a0adda89.name: Exodus-10 Laser Beam
9fd3b3be-5653-413f-ba8f-0959a0adda89.desc: Built in conjunction with the engineers at Aegis, this bespoke laser beam weapon from Hurston Dynamics is highly accurate, giving the Idris-K a devastating weapon in its arsenal.

35e1362f-a28d-4db5-b514-569c62f56a45.name: Supremacy-10T Laser Beam
35e1362f-a28d-4db5-b514-569c62f56a45.desc: Developed in concert with the weapons specialists of Aegis to form part of the dedicated anti-capital ship loadout of the Tiburon, the Supremacy-10T combines surgical precision with devastating destructive power.

ed951ee5-0873-45e8-92b2-586a277f4ba6.name: Attrition-1 Repeater
ed951ee5-0873-45e8-92b2-586a277f4ba6.desc: The Attrition-1 laser repeater features Hurston Dynamics' unique cascade technology which provides increased performance while sustained laser fire is maintained. The result is a size one weapon that rewards a deft operator.

ea6b4297-83a4-476f-aee0-9d4f87168cf7.name: Attrition-2 Repeater
ea6b4297-83a4-476f-aee0-9d4f87168cf7.desc: When the battle is heating up, that's when Hurston Dynamics' cascade laser technology really shines. With the size two Attrition-2 repeater, an operator can utilize sustained bursts of laser fire in order to translate excess heat into greater weapon performance.

c526f686-a3da-48fa-b9c3-d58fb8e31dc5.name: Attrition-3 Repeater
c526f686-a3da-48fa-b9c3-d58fb8e31dc5.desc: Rather than limiting their weapon's performance to increase stability, Hurston Dynamics' cascade technology allows the operator to decide. While overheating is a risk, longer periods of sustained fire with the Attrition-3 laser repeater will increase performance as excess heat is translated into greater energy output.

8d868b78-eccd-4ba5-a4a5-57e2f20bdc35.name: Attrition-4 Repeater
8d868b78-eccd-4ba5-a4a5-57e2f20bdc35.desc: Hurston Dynamics has fully integrated it's cascade laser technology into their Attrition-line of repeaters. The size four Attrition-4 is no exception, operating at peak performance when near its maximum thermal capacity.

2c9b3880-a108-4746-a6cd-7e2b04feee36.name: Attrition-5 Repeater
2c9b3880-a108-4746-a6cd-7e2b04feee36.desc: More than a simple size five laser repeater, the Attrition-5 from Hurston Dynamics features advanced cascade technology to allow the weapon significant performance improvements the longer it sustains its energy output.

f02c1934-9ebb-413c-9f3e-cbcb262f25de.name: Attrition-6 Repeater
f02c1934-9ebb-413c-9f3e-cbcb262f25de.desc: With Hurston Dynamics' cascade technology, the Attrition-6 laser repeater maximizes it's combat potential. It's common for weapons to heat up when used heavily in combat, but what sets this size six repeater apart is that thermal energy is translating directly into increased offensive strength.

beabe016-3fb4-4e3f-b464-374076d91f04.name: Dominance-1 Scattergun
beabe016-3fb4-4e3f-b464-374076d91f04.desc: Thanks to its integration of Hurston Dynamics' laser cascade technology, the Dominance-1 scattergun is able to deliver more damage the closer the size one weapon operates to its maximum safe thermal capacity.

ac55431a-d662-4d92-bda7-ea44f27ca597.name: Dominance-2 Scattergun
ac55431a-d662-4d92-bda7-ea44f27ca597.desc: The harder the fight, the harder the Dominance-2 scattergun works. As its thermal levels increase, the size two weapon from Hurston Dynamics is able utilize cascade technology to turn that thermal potential into an even deadlier close-quarters attack.

5f31f7c2-1383-4d77-892b-24507515ab0b.name: Dominance-3 Scattergun
5f31f7c2-1383-4d77-892b-24507515ab0b.desc: The Dominance-3 scattergun from Hurston Dynamics showcases the weapons manufacturer's cascade technology. As the operator continues to fire the size three weapon, the better able it is to convert the heat generated into increasingly devastating attacks.

189b0ce2-d934-4208-9970-ac633dbd67d3.name: Slayer Cannon
189b0ce2-d934-4208-9970-ac633dbd67d3.desc: Designed specifically for the Nova tank, Hurston Dynamics' Slayer ballistic cannon earned its illustrious reputation through countless battlefield engagements during the Second Tevarin War. This battlefield beast excels against armored targets and fortified emplacements by firing large caliber artillery rounds with astounding accuracy and velocity. Hurston worked closely with Tumbril when the tank manufacturer decided to bring back the Nova. Though they painstakingly honored the original Slayer design, Hurston also updated it for the 30th century by improving the pivot speed, heat resistance, and associated software to provide a state-of-the-art gunner UI.

aa7c924e-3f3b-4cea-a948-77753e2b387e.name: Reign-3 Repeater
aa7c924e-3f3b-4cea-a948-77753e2b387e.desc: Hurston Dynamics has partnered with Tumbril Land Systems to craft the powerful Reign-3 laser repeater specifically for the Storm assault vehicle's turret. Utilizing Hurston Dynamics' proprietary cascade technology, the Reign-3 delivers increased performance and greater energy output as the frenetic pace of combat starts to heat up.

d195eb47-24b8-45c0-a4d0-1771d60dc1a8.name: Suckerpunch Cannon
d195eb47-24b8-45c0-a4d0-1771d60dc1a8.desc: The geniuses over at Joker have done it again. The Suckerpunch Distortion autocannon is a long-range weapon that drains your target's power supply rather than damaging the physical body of the ship, making it ideal for law-enforcement or other applications.

70a98c94-9252-4fd3-a673-5a584339e273.name: Suckerpunch-L Cannon
70a98c94-9252-4fd3-a673-5a584339e273.desc: Silently strike from afar with the Suckerpunch. Joker's long-range size two distortion cannon drains a target's power system, leaving them helpless to defend against what you have planned next. An ideal choice for law enforcement, bounty hunters, and other non-lethal operations.

e09590d1-13a0-4d25-ad89-3dfc18a61c4a.name: Suckerpunch-XL Cannon
e09590d1-13a0-4d25-ad89-3dfc18a61c4a.desc: When you want to catch your prey without doing damage use the Suckerpunch. This size three distortion cannon from Joker depletes the target's power system, making it an excellent and effective non-lethal addition to your arsenal.

85fd75f8-6c6c-4d3f-839f-988ae7660617.name: 9-Series Longsword Cannon
85fd75f8-6c6c-4d3f-839f-988ae7660617.desc: The entry level autocannon of the KnightBridge Arms Sword-line, the 9-Series Longsword fires a ballistic round designed for use against a variety of armored hostiles while allowing pilots to keep a healthy distance from targets.

02a7f68a-5bdd-4887-a256-20c985a65bda.name: 10-Series Greatsword Cannon
02a7f68a-5bdd-4887-a256-20c985a65bda.desc: KnightBridge Arms knows that when it comes to battle, having the right weapon can make all the difference. With its powerful ballistic rounds, the versatile, size two 10-Series Greatsword will see you through to the conflict's end thanks to it long range and high damage potential.

f03daac4-28e2-405c-b226-c258151cb9f1.name: 11-Series Broadsword Cannon
f03daac4-28e2-405c-b226-c258151cb9f1.desc: The 11-Series Broadsword from KnightBridge Arms is the size three ballistic autocannon pilots come to when they want the 3 D’s: distance, dependability and damage.

c9c2bb19-3298-448e-a117-043e082a1c74.name: CF-117 Bulldog Repeater
c9c2bb19-3298-448e-a117-043e082a1c74.desc: Featuring a three-barrel sequential fire design, the Klaus & Werner CF-117 Bulldog laser repeater is capable of delivering high velocity energy rounds while maintaining heat efficiency making it a favorite among new pilots who are outfitting their first ship.

b6560a92-d608-40d9-ba56-3207a71c0948.name: CF-117 Bulldog "Hazard-Zone" Repeater
b6560a92-d608-40d9-ba56-3207a71c0948.desc: Featuring a three-barrel sequential fire design, the Klaus & Werner CF-117 Bulldog laser repeater is capable of delivering high velocity energy rounds while maintaining heat efficiency making it a favorite among new pilots who are outfitting their first ship. The Hazard-Zone edition, adorned with striking mustard yellow highlights on a black base, will have you armed and ready to fight in style.

5453a817-dfd4-4143-aa11-840ca428540c.name: CF-227 Badger Repeater
5453a817-dfd4-4143-aa11-840ca428540c.desc: The CF-227 Badger is Klaus & Werner’s dependable size two repeating laser. Its increased output and high rate of fire make it a solid contender in any fight.

43370d53-f207-4189-bc95-c5b98c8db0d0.name: CF-227 Badger "Hazard-Zone" Repeater
43370d53-f207-4189-bc95-c5b98c8db0d0.desc: The CF-227 Badger is Klaus & Werner’s dependable size two repeating laser. Its increased output and high rate of fire make it a solid contender in any fight. The Hazard-Zone edition, adorned with striking mustard yellow highlights on a black base, will have you armed and ready to fight in style.

bd13235d-1261-4b71-b32f-aed1a8beb526.name: CF-337 Panther Repeater
bd13235d-1261-4b71-b32f-aed1a8beb526.desc: The CF-337 Panther is the size three model in Klaus & Werner's laser repeater line. The Panther is a true fire-and-forget weapon with a respectable power consumption-to-damage ratio. Pilots who outfit their ships with Panthers rarely regret the decision.

e4870a3c-b2f8-462b-8be2-dd04520551cf.name: CF-337 Panther "Hazard-Zone" Repeater
e4870a3c-b2f8-462b-8be2-dd04520551cf.desc: The CF-337 Panther is the size three model in Klaus & Werner's laser repeater line. The Panther is a true fire-and-forget weapon with a respectable power consumption-to-damage ratio. Pilots who outfit their ships with Panthers rarely regret the decision. The Hazard-Zone edition, adorned with striking mustard yellow highlights on a black base, will have you armed and ready to fight in style.

ecac1df2-4f6f-49df-9cce-f188d118a789.name: CF-447 Rhino Repeater
ecac1df2-4f6f-49df-9cce-f188d118a789.desc: When a ship comes charging at you with a CF-447 Rhino strapped on, it is an experience few pilots will ever forget. This formidable size four laser repeater from Klaus & Werner is well suited for medium-range engagements, but packs a wallop up close.

4170fcb0-0cef-4228-a3d5-7efc41ba4ea3.name: CF-557 Galdereen Repeater
4170fcb0-0cef-4228-a3d5-7efc41ba4ea3.desc: With a bite as fearsome as its fanged namesake, the Klaus & Werner CF-557 Galdereen laser repeater is a solid choice for a wide range of vehicles thanks to its high rate of fire and consistent efficacy.

3bb64389-e75d-463e-a73b-115bf132667e.name: CF-667 Mammoth Repeater
3bb64389-e75d-463e-a73b-115bf132667e.desc: This beast of a laser repeater from Klaus & Werner features three massive barrels that warn any who spot a ship bearing the CF-667 that they may want to think again before engaging.

43269af0-736e-4232-8cfe-271367b28ee1.name: Sledge I Mass Driver Cannon
43269af0-736e-4232-8cfe-271367b28ee1.desc: Take down distant targets with the Sledge I Mass Driver Cannon. Klaus & Werner utilized railgun technology to accurately fire high damage ballistic projectiles over long distances. Be sure to make every shot count though, as the weapon sacrifices rate of fire for raw, devastating damage.

26298097-2f16-4f25-b652-9c72170b5529.name: Destroyer Mass Driver Cannon
26298097-2f16-4f25-b652-9c72170b5529.desc: Made for the Aegis Idris utilizing railgun technology to accurately fire high damage ballistic projectiles over long distances, the Destroyer mass driver from Klaus & Werner has made it's presence known on the battlefield time and again with devastating impact.

c657c03c-6ac6-4da6-ab70-bfab52804444.name: Sledge II Mass Driver Cannon
c657c03c-6ac6-4da6-ab70-bfab52804444.desc: The Klaus & Werner Sledge II Mass Driver Cannon is a hard-hitting ballistic weapon capable of firing multiple types of ammunition. This weapon’s increased shield penetration capabilities comes at a cost, however. Magazine space is limited, so ammunition must be replenished regularly. Because it does not use energy-based projectiles, the K&W mass driver has a reduced power cost and therefore results in a reduced EM signature.

ccd05b20-4042-4c49-a4c0-4a94f6d841ee.name: Sledge III Mass Driver Cannon
ccd05b20-4042-4c49-a4c0-4a94f6d841ee.desc: The Sledge III is the size three variant of Klaus & Werner's popular mass driver cannon series. Though slow to fire, the weapon successfully blends the company's philosophy of simple design with cutting edge railgun technology to fire ballistic projectiles with surgical precision at range.

ea0217e9-cdbe-48d2-a192-1837c52130b9.name: Relentless L-21 Gatling
ea0217e9-cdbe-48d2-a192-1837c52130b9.desc: Enemies will regret getting within range of the L-21 Wolf and its bespoke Relentless L-21 gatling. Kruger's expert engineering allows this rotary cannon to fire rounds at a head spinning speed with little worry of a misfire.

d018aa87-d395-4935-8660-af9bda648b03.name: Tigerstrike T-19P
d018aa87-d395-4935-8660-af9bda648b03.desc: A custom variant on Kruger Intergalactic’s Tigerstrike line of rotary cannons, this powerful gun was designed in conjunction with the team working on the P-52 Merlin to ensure that it fit seamlessly with the graceful lines of light fighter’s hull while still rapidly delivering round after round with the dependability that one expects from a Kruger weapon.

cfacea3e-afbc-405c-b220-2d1d3b6e20b1.name: Quarreler Cannon
cfacea3e-afbc-405c-b220-2d1d3b6e20b1.desc: Crafted with precision manufactured parts forged to extremely tight tolerances, designed for top-of-class heat management and assembled to exceed all industry standards, the Quarreler laser autocannon was created by Kruger Intergalactic for true defensive dependability.

fdac3503-07a6-48cb-9656-3a00c617cfb2.name: Whiptail STR-E2 Repeater
fdac3503-07a6-48cb-9656-3a00c617cfb2.desc: Designed for the Stringray to unleash a torrent of laser fire, this custom made laser repeater is capable of firing in rapid succession to strip away defenses.

890880a7-afa7-41f9-bc1c-925d7958a436.name: Axiom L-22 Repeater
890880a7-afa7-41f9-bc1c-925d7958a436.desc: Meticulous design makes the Axiom L-22 an ideal armament for the L-22 Alpha Wolf. Premium parts and cutting-edge manufacturing have created a laser repeater made to thrive in the heat of battle.

3d562dad-88f9-43aa-8ed5-616bf6634ff9.name: FL-11 Cannon
3d562dad-88f9-43aa-8ed5-616bf6634ff9.desc: Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. The FL-11 might shoot slow but provides considerable firepower for a size one weapon.

ee3e42f7-56ea-46b8-bac2-d27187005a70.name: FL-22 Cannon
ee3e42f7-56ea-46b8-bac2-d27187005a70.desc: Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. The size two FL-22 shines at medium and long ranges thanks to a design that minimizes damage falloff.

3a5bd643-3c3e-42fb-87ce-2a44b976555d.name: FL-33 Cannon
3a5bd643-3c3e-42fb-87ce-2a44b976555d.desc: Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. Embodying Kroneg's practical design philosophy, the FL-33 remains one of the most reliable and destructive size three laser cannons currently available.

3fc83638-fbe5-4d75-8e18-678736fefbc4.name: NN-13 Cannon
3fc83638-fbe5-4d75-8e18-678736fefbc4.desc: MaxOx’s NN-13 neutron cannon offers a massive energy payload at the expense of speed and energy efficiency. One could argue the virtues of speed, rate of fire and distance over damage, but the argument becomes irrelevant if you only need to hit them once.

596ced46-195e-4f60-826a-7cc5bb2e2f02.name: NN-14 Cannon
596ced46-195e-4f60-826a-7cc5bb2e2f02.desc: Building on the technology of the NN-13, MaxOx’s NN-14 offers a significant increase in power for the neutron autocannon to give each shot a devastating punch. With that increased damage however, comes a heavier draw on your power plant.

231fd67b-49a6-40e9-8eef-20268cfc0b2c.name: NN-15 Cannon
231fd67b-49a6-40e9-8eef-20268cfc0b2c.desc: Building on the technology of the successful NN-series, MaxOx’s NN-15 offers a significant increase in power for the neutron autocannon to give each shot a devastating punch. With that increased damage however, comes a heavier draw on your power plant.

fecbf518-e3e5-4e58-905a-729a02e86265.name: NDB-26 Repeater
fecbf518-e3e5-4e58-905a-729a02e86265.desc: The NDB-26 uses a twin barrel system to fire neutron projectiles at a rapid rate. Devastating at close range, this neutron repeater still packs enough of a wallop at medium range to persuade any attackers to reconsider their assault.

2365f40c-fbd3-4859-ad80-f5cfbc305c83.name: NDB-28 Repeater
2365f40c-fbd3-4859-ad80-f5cfbc305c83.desc: Featuring a sleek, scientific design, the MaxOx NDB-28 is the next step in serious stopping power. Twin barrels overlap blasts for sustained neutron fire that remains effective at short to medium range.

2f9fad1d-f591-4e69-ae64-af5ba0a883f7.name: NDB-30 Repeater
2f9fad1d-f591-4e69-ae64-af5ba0a883f7.desc: Decades of design work went into perfecting the NDB line of neutron repeaters. The S3 NDB-30 rapidly fires powerful and precise neutron projectiles that will quickly deter anyone foolish enough to get too close.

ebf157d4-5b04-4f0c-95a4-ad22b34b0cce.name: Ardor-1 Salvaged Repeater
ebf157d4-5b04-4f0c-95a4-ad22b34b0cce.desc: This Ardor-1 laser repeater was salvaged in the Pyro system. First manufactured in 2724, the Ardor series became popular for its split barrel design that helped mitigate heat when sustaining fire. Hurston eventually stopped manufacturing the weapon in favor of the Attrition line of laser repeaters. Despite the effects of time and constant usage, the weapon is still sought after because of the consistent performance delivered by Hurston Dynamic's expert design and solid construction.

d6decc9e-ec4f-4bab-a0bc-5e1dc01d7af7.name: Ardor-2 Salvaged Repeater
d6decc9e-ec4f-4bab-a0bc-5e1dc01d7af7.desc: This Ardor-2 laser repeater was salvaged in the Pyro system. First manufactured in 2724, the Ardor series became popular for its split barrel design that helped mitigate heat when sustaining fire. Hurston eventually stopped manufacturing the weapon in favor of the Attrition line of laser repeaters. Despite the effects of time and constant usage, the weapon is still sought after because of the consistent performance delivered by Hurston Dynamic's expert design and solid construction.

47f6c5d4-32f6-4813-9a34-a55d3c2d8aac.name: Ardor-3 Salvaged Repeater
47f6c5d4-32f6-4813-9a34-a55d3c2d8aac.desc: This Ardor-3 laser repeater was salvaged in the Pyro system. First manufactured in 2724, the Ardor series became popular for its split barrel design that helped mitigate heat when sustaining fire. Hurston eventually stopped manufacturing the weapon in favor of the Attrition line of laser repeaters. Despite the effects of time and constant usage, the weapon is still sought after because of the consistent performance delivered by Hurston Dynamic's expert design and solid construction.

76706adf-4687-4a7a-aaf1-c44af0a5d2ca.name: Salvation Distortion Scattergun
76706adf-4687-4a7a-aaf1-c44af0a5d2ca.desc: Disable an enemy's ship without damaging it with the Salvation scattergun from Preacher Armaments. With its wide spread and low rate of fire this size four scattergun is most potent at close range.

2e0a3446-23e2-447b-8f1c-2b01516ca396.name: Absolution Distortion Scattergun
2e0a3446-23e2-447b-8f1c-2b01516ca396.desc: Deliver high distortion damage in close quarters with Preacher Armaments' Absolution scattergun. This size five weapon is an ideal loadout option for those interested in capturing or boarding their target.

bad19f5c-7249-4d85-9430-040733eb6e4a.name: Condemnation Distortion Scattergun
bad19f5c-7249-4d85-9430-040733eb6e4a.desc: The Condemnation is a massive size six scattergun from Preacher Armaments. Its high distortion damage incapacitates the electronics, though its wide spreads makes it less effective as the target gets farther away.

2f92d27a-f04f-47f9-aeb5-96ad4fad15ea.name: Leonids Cannon
2f92d27a-f04f-47f9-aeb5-96ad4fad15ea.desc: Built specifically for the Meteor, the Leonids ballistic cannon provides formidable firepower designed to overwhelm aggressors that dare get within range. RSI expertly incorporated the cannon atop both sides of the ship to seamlessly integrate with the ship's components and provide full forward coverage.

61d5e767-fcee-4e70-ae9e-7671b6692404.name: Maris Cannon
61d5e767-fcee-4e70-ae9e-7671b6692404.desc: This powerful ballistic cannon was designed by RSI as a bespoke armament for their Polaris corvette.

c22b9f48-3146-4b7f-ae57-4f0b40c2f944.name: Echion Repeater
c22b9f48-3146-4b7f-ae57-4f0b40c2f944.desc: Designed to overwhelm shields with a barrage of laserfire, this custom-made RSI Echion laser repeater will strip enemies of their defenses leaving them vulnerable to more devastating attacks.

17417d27-af6d-40fc-af97-ab6db7ab313c.name: RSI Medusa Cannon
17417d27-af6d-40fc-af97-ab6db7ab313c.desc: Building on centuries of RSI weapon technology, the Perseus utilizes bespoke size 8 Medusa Cannons that deliver devastating salvos of ballistic fire, capable of starting fights just as easily as ending them. These custom made RSI cannons excel at punishing larger targets at long, making it a formidable battlefield equalizer.

6e3a862f-d13e-4873-ba34-24f3e554984d.name: Thlilye Laser Gatling
6e3a862f-d13e-4873-ba34-24f3e554984d.desc: Experience the cutting edge of Xi'an technology with the Thlilye laser gatling, designed by Torral Aggregate. Made exclusively for the Mirai Pulse, this size 2, fully automatic laser gatling features a lightning-quick rate of fire, making it ideal for close-range battle.

a9780953-9488-4644-9b56-61464e9dd6b9.name: Yeng’tu Repeater
a9780953-9488-4644-9b56-61464e9dd6b9.desc: Inspired by Xi'an mil-tech and tailor-made by Torral Aggregate exclusively for the Aopoa San'tok.yāi, the Yeng'tu laser repeater accentuates the ship's dexterity with a fighter's edge.

2148a144-a9a2-457c-8bb5-e96f0492a0bc.name: 'WRATH' Cannon
2148a144-a9a2-457c-8bb5-e96f0492a0bc.desc: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WRATH'.

00ab31a0-7de2-44f7-a567-7ff88fdbad49.name: 'WEAK' Repeater
00ab31a0-7de2-44f7-a567-7ff88fdbad49.desc: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WEAK'.

80ab18bb-9bc2-4e4f-a407-06c28e69bea7.name: 'WASP' Repeater
80ab18bb-9bc2-4e4f-a407-06c28e69bea7.desc: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WASP'.

816aa854-7615-4add-a2ca-2d39ada7fea7.name: 'WAR' Cannon
816aa854-7615-4add-a2ca-2d39ada7fea7.desc: This neutron cannon is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WAR'.

fde9335b-a9b7-4d7d-a4a4-69b1158de320.name: 'WRATH' Cannon
fde9335b-a9b7-4d7d-a4a4-69b1158de320.desc: This laser repeater is typically found on Vanduul war ships and is commonly known by its UEE Navy designation of 'WRATH'.

4d3e0757-eec3-44ec-b603-5eaafa6c80ac.name: Yebira I
4d3e0757-eec3-44ec-b603-5eaafa6c80ac.desc: The Yebira I rocket pod is the perfect system for efficient deployment of S3 ordnance. Manufactured by Firestorm Kinetics, this rocket pod carries three rockets and attaches to any size one hardpoint.

679d7f26-7539-4414-976d-0c809ba89933.name: Jericho
679d7f26-7539-4414-976d-0c809ba89933.desc: The Jericho rocket pod from Hurston Dynamics is compatible with any size one hardpoint and capable of carrying six S1 rockets.

065e4a72-1226-42d7-8be0-62865c8b6ebc.name: Liberator
065e4a72-1226-42d7-8be0-62865c8b6ebc.desc: Thermyte Concern's Liberator rocket pod carries four S2 rockets and can be attached to any size one hardpoint.

2f525576-8894-4bc6-baf1-d08a8c21cabc.name: Yebira II
2f525576-8894-4bc6-baf1-d08a8c21cabc.desc: The Yebira II rocket pod is the perfect system for efficient deployment of S3 ordnance. Manufactured by Firestorm Kinetics, this rocket pod carries six rockets and attaches to any size two hardpoint.

06c3eecf-c6e5-4f63-91ab-158103f04e4a.name: Jericho X
06c3eecf-c6e5-4f63-91ab-158103f04e4a.desc: The Jericho X rocket pod from Hurston Dynamics is compatible with any size two hardpoint and capable of carrying twelve S1 rockets.

5ed1f1ec-6ebc-463b-9529-83382e20624d.name: Liberator Prime
5ed1f1ec-6ebc-463b-9529-83382e20624d.desc: Thermyte Concern's Liberator Prime rocket pod carries eight S2 rockets and can be attached to any size two hardpoint.

4312c1a5-f575-4e06-9892-2c5270982e9e.name: Jericho XL
4312c1a5-f575-4e06-9892-2c5270982e9e.desc: The Jericho XL rocket pod from Hurston Dynamics is compatible with any size three hardpoint and capable of carrying eighteen S1 rockets.

501a4017-d754-43d7-933b-72773d761303.name: Jericho XL
501a4017-d754-43d7-933b-72773d761303.desc: The Jericho XL rocket pod from Hurston Dynamics is compatible with any size three hardpoint and capable of carrying eighteen S1 rockets.

de76d4a8-c71c-4368-8b57-1474b4a4a3a6.name: Liberator Ultra
de76d4a8-c71c-4368-8b57-1474b4a4a3a6.desc: Thermyte Concern's Liberator Ultra rocket pod carries twelve S2 rockets and can be attached to any size three hardpoint.

6ed772d7-ba17-4bf1-ae49-0a6ff82be1a9.name: RS-Barrier
6ed772d7-ba17-4bf1-ae49-0a6ff82be1a9.desc: Designed to defend against the debris common during large-scale salvage projects, Aegis Dynamics developed this bespoke industrial shield generator in-house for the Reclaimer.

48e2b865-a936-4346-a621-582568ebd008.name: Cloak
48e2b865-a936-4346-a621-582568ebd008.desc: Discreet security is within your reach thanks to this small shield generator from Ascension Astro. With a lower signature then many other generators in its class, the Cloak provides protection without drawing unnecessary attention.

94807046-b89e-422d-8bbc-f914b1cbc08d.name: Mirage
94807046-b89e-422d-8bbc-f914b1cbc08d.desc: By boasting a signature so faint most won’t believe it’s there, Ascension Astro’s top of the line small shield generator lives up to its name — Mirage. It’s the ultimate component for those who want to go unnoticed.

ecc8d200-548c-4de0-a60e-d1e316515170.name: Shimmer
ecc8d200-548c-4de0-a60e-d1e316515170.desc: Ascension Astro is known for one thing — quality stealth components. Their Shimmer shield generator was built not only to help avoid detection, but also provide protection when needed most.

32e241cf-130e-4b00-8752-0da67e98a40f.name: Veil
32e241cf-130e-4b00-8752-0da67e98a40f.desc: An advanced cooling system significantly reduces the heat produced by the Veil stealth shield generator. No other component in its class even comes close to rivaling its heat suppression technology.

5f3fced2-3c4a-4a50-8a3e-4ba36064854c.name: Obscura
5f3fced2-3c4a-4a50-8a3e-4ba36064854c.desc: Respected for its lower emissions, the Obscura shield generator uses an advanced signature dispersal system to help give your ship a quieter signature while still remaining shielded.

d8c15fce-d188-4ce4-b303-196bc733b5d7.name: Sheut
d8c15fce-d188-4ce4-b303-196bc733b5d7.desc: Keep your shield’s heat from giving you away by using a Sheut. Another outstanding stealth shield generator from Ascension Astro.

b097ed3e-ee5e-4f18-ae79-dcf49687e27d.name: Shroud
b097ed3e-ee5e-4f18-ae79-dcf49687e27d.desc: The Shroud shield generator from Ascension Astro provides a layer of protection for your vessel while still helping you maintain emission levels to provide a lower signature.

6bec0a0a-9214-448c-96ea-272fc9302a27.name: Umbra
6bec0a0a-9214-448c-96ea-272fc9302a27.desc: Slip through the darkness of space like a phantom with the Umbra stealth shield generator. Best when used in conjunction with other low signature components from Ascension Astro.

f8d44a06-9b5e-49c1-a578-8e45386c2539.name: Suldrath
f8d44a06-9b5e-49c1-a578-8e45386c2539.desc: Classic Tevarin tech melds with modern design for the Suldrath shield generator. The Banu beautifully blend the best parts of historic Tevarin shield tech with contemporary upgrades and conveniences expected of this component generation. The result is an effective and unique xeno-crafted shield ready to shroud your ship and protect you from whatever dangers come your way.

39e7e5bf-27ba-4e45-914f-3fcc79a8886c.name: Sukoran
39e7e5bf-27ba-4e45-914f-3fcc79a8886c.desc: Good design always survives with the Banu. The Sukoran shield generator updates Tevarin technology in a number of interesting ways. Its efficient design draws less power, while still effectively producing a robust shield capable of absorbing most ballistic and energy attacks until it's fully depleted. However, this greater efficiency comes with a price as the Sukoran's slower regen rate may temporarily render the shield offline.

e11f94ed-6a41-4960-b895-4a604ec98e97.name: Castra
e11f94ed-6a41-4960-b895-4a604ec98e97.desc: When performance meets price for vehicle shield generators, the Castra is the clear winner. It has been a Whitley’s Guide “Best Buy” for five consecutive years.

624e6c75-afd8-4606-a10e-45d12cb3c882.name: Bulwark
624e6c75-afd8-4606-a10e-45d12cb3c882.desc: The Bulwark shield generator provides industrial-grade durability and increased performance, but at the expense of a higher emission level.

f8cd46b2-2db9-4252-adf0-c44ad36bdf7c.name: Guardian
f8cd46b2-2db9-4252-adf0-c44ad36bdf7c.desc: Upgrade to the Guardian for increased absorption of ballistic, energy, and distortion damage. Making this industrial shield generator one of the most durable in its class.

15ebdff2-2724-4fb3-abbf-db20e150da77.name: Palisade
15ebdff2-2724-4fb3-abbf-db20e150da77.desc: No other small shield generator can match the durability of the Basilisk Palisade. This top-of-the-line industrial component forfeits stealth for the ability to absorb an unrivaled amount of damage.

b1454c7b-859d-4e78-9429-e05391242ca7.name: Steward
b1454c7b-859d-4e78-9429-e05391242ca7.desc: The Steward is Basilisk’s entry-level industrial shield generator. Its reinforced housing adds an extra level of durability to an already robust system, guaranteeing that your shield will be projecting even in the harshest conditions.

7ff2c313-51c7-459b-91e5-8afd089df32f.name: Armada
7ff2c313-51c7-459b-91e5-8afd089df32f.desc: Basilisk started by making cutting edge hull plating that was renowned for being durable and dependable. Today they carry on that proud legacy with industrial shield generators like the Armada.

37ae6971-46d1-4021-bb9f-353813df8e9f.name: Aspis
37ae6971-46d1-4021-bb9f-353813df8e9f.desc: Basilisk’s Aspis industrial shield generator features durable design and reliable performance, earning it a place on Whitley’s Guide ‘Best Buy’ list.

a7dd60d3-10bf-473d-9de5-747071885573.name: Citadel
a7dd60d3-10bf-473d-9de5-747071885573.desc: Fortify your ship with Basilisk’s Citadel shield generator. Tailored toward industrial vessels, the component emits a robust and reliable shield.

a4ce7916-5eeb-4b40-af71-8558f246e5e5.name: Rampart
a4ce7916-5eeb-4b40-af71-8558f246e5e5.desc: Basilisk understands that escape isn’t always an option. That’s why they built the Rampart industrial shield generator to take an incredible amount of damage before it’s depleted.

e538a97f-d9cd-4997-9f43-11450e364af1.name: Barbican
e538a97f-d9cd-4997-9f43-11450e364af1.desc: Barricade your ship against external forces with the Basilisk Barbican. Originally fabricated for large industrial vessels, this shield generator has became quite popular due to its high damage absorption.

8d0556f4-b325-4a00-b901-9835f8ee163d.name: Parapet
8d0556f4-b325-4a00-b901-9835f8ee163d.desc: As the peak of Basilisk’s large industrial shield generators, it’s easy to see why the Parapet is so beloved. With one of the industry’s best shield generation to damage ratio, it’s difficult to degrade the shield and expose the hull.

3a2e37f0-dc95-4082-b74d-fe968ed64eb3.name: Stronghold
3a2e37f0-dc95-4082-b74d-fe968ed64eb3.desc: The Stronghold shield generator uses patented hull plating techniques to reinforce the generator’s body to make it one of the sturdiest on the market. That means the shield and component are both built to last.

2a0bcc2c-769a-4689-a9bc-dde5516c6d1b.name: Ward
2a0bcc2c-769a-4689-a9bc-dde5516c6d1b.desc: The Ward is Basilisk’s basic industrial-grade shield generator for large ships. It provides decent performance and durability while also keeping its signature respectable.

9d309719-800c-4d42-946e-fa6c240bc2df.name: 5SA 'Rhada'
9d309719-800c-4d42-946e-fa6c240bc2df.desc: The 5SA ‘Rhada’ delivers Behring’s expert engineering and trusted performance to make it a worthy shield generator for any commercial ship.

69eab676-9cc1-4e42-bacd-3fa9a78081ee.name: 6SA 'Arbiter'
69eab676-9cc1-4e42-bacd-3fa9a78081ee.desc: Providing above average shield health and damage absorption, the 6SA ‘Arbiter’ has been a trusted component for centuries. Experience the Behring advantage by installing this small shield generator today.

b1e490ef-86d6-466a-afb1-3875028b7a8a.name: 7SA 'Concord'
b1e490ef-86d6-466a-afb1-3875028b7a8a.desc: A top-of-the-line shield generator that runs loud and proud. What it sacrifices in stealth it more than makes up for with supreme durability and excellent performance. So, even if enemies see you coming, they’ll have a hard time disabling Behring’s 7SA ‘Concord’.

8c2b0c60-881b-4163-9d72-b6b74806735a.name: 5MA 'Chimalli'
8c2b0c60-881b-4163-9d72-b6b74806735a.desc: Thanks to Behring’s expert engineers, the 5MA ‘Chimalli’ shield generator balances the need for a solid regeneration rate with dependable damage absorption.

39424912-de99-46d1-87a6-0f59696ca60b.name: 6MA 'Kozane'
39424912-de99-46d1-87a6-0f59696ca60b.desc: Behring’s ironclad reputation is almost as impenetrable as the shield produced by the 6MA ‘Kozane’. If it’s good enough for Behring, it’s good enough for you.

fb145cc4-2e30-44a0-865d-b9ea0e40fae1.name: 7MA 'Lorica'
fb145cc4-2e30-44a0-865d-b9ea0e40fae1.desc: Trust a component that has been equipped on crafts for centuries — the 7MA ‘Lorica’. Experience Behring’s top-of-the-line shield generator on your ship today.

51bf9a6e-0ad7-49d2-8d41-d1d5e69669e6.name: 5CA 'Akura'
51bf9a6e-0ad7-49d2-8d41-d1d5e69669e6.desc: Behring’s belief in balanced shield design is evident with the 5CA. This large shield generator is equally focused on providing acceptable shield health along with decent damage absorption.

6534d6d3-85dc-4c29-aa3d-80cab37c4fa5.name: 6CA 'Bila'
6534d6d3-85dc-4c29-aa3d-80cab37c4fa5.desc: “Built by Behring” is a phrase synonymous with quality. That’s why so many around the Empire trust their 6CA ‘Bila’ large shield generator to provide them with solid performance, impressive durable, and an acceptable degree of stealth.

9bf5b169-b3cb-4c34-bbad-6faf1bfc2e29.name: 7CA 'Nargun'
9bf5b169-b3cb-4c34-bbad-6faf1bfc2e29.desc: Commercial-grade shield generators don’t get any better than the 7CA ‘Nargun’. The component utilizes Behring’s patented ‘Freeze Flow’ tech to keep its heat signature in check while increasing both its overall performance and durability.

339bd641-8dfb-4bc1-b273-5ffc5f702fbb.name: AllStop
339bd641-8dfb-4bc1-b273-5ffc5f702fbb.desc: Gorgon Defender Industries first created the AllStop shield generator to hold off the Vanduul. They worked so well that many military crafts were known to prefer the AllStop. Just one of the many reasons to have one on your ship.

bbd925a4-2699-4d8c-b513-5a97d4f9ca7c.name: AllStop
bbd925a4-2699-4d8c-b513-5a97d4f9ca7c.desc: Gorgon Defender Industries first created the AllStop shield generator to hold off the Vanduul. They worked so well that many military crafts were known to prefer the AllStop. Just one of the many reasons to have one on your ship.

b66a64ca-9c53-40e7-8618-3b66b10a021c.name: ForceWall
b66a64ca-9c53-40e7-8618-3b66b10a021c.desc: Want to stay in the thick of battle a bit longer? Gorgon’s ForceWall is a military-grade shield generator that’s able to absorb more damage, providing a notable uptick to your shield’s durability.

0baaf20a-460e-4668-84f2-d09f9d31b492.name: FR-66
0baaf20a-460e-4668-84f2-d09f9d31b492.desc: The FR-66 is one of the most versatile small shield generator currently on the market. Get military strength protection and performance from Gorgon Defender Industries to ensure your ship can survive any onslaught.

334e6cb2-5e77-4bc8-bd92-d756848f050b.name: SecureHyde
334e6cb2-5e77-4bc8-bd92-d756848f050b.desc: Get extra protection with the SecureHyde shield generator. This military-grade component provides superior durability over every other shield generator in its class.

b14fb966-10f0-4207-8a41-2317798deccc.name: CoverAll
b14fb966-10f0-4207-8a41-2317798deccc.desc: Don’t sacrifice performance for durability. Get both with Gorgon Defender Industries’ CoverAll shield generator.

be9729fb-c973-4c49-93cb-6a6f7c877408.name: FR-76
be9729fb-c973-4c49-93cb-6a6f7c877408.desc: Refined by years of extensive, real world testing by the military, Gorgon Defender Industries FR-76 is the ultimate shield generator. Perfect for everyone from folks defending the frontline to those exploring the frontier.

924e275a-d449-44f5-a8a8-6e0e93a9661e.name: FullStop
924e275a-d449-44f5-a8a8-6e0e93a9661e.desc: Featuring proprietary recoil tech, the FullStop shield generator was built to better absorb attacks from a multitude of damage types.

c8b42a1b-2000-4d7e-8888-208480c739b6.name: SecureShield
c8b42a1b-2000-4d7e-8888-208480c739b6.desc: Get military-grade protection for your ship with the SecureShield from Gorgon Defender Industries. Their cutting edge emitter tech allows for superior shield absorption across the spectrum of damage types.

5fa67088-9677-40c4-b552-46c16bd7162e.name: FR-86
5fa67088-9677-40c4-b552-46c16bd7162e.desc: Gorgon’s FR-86 is tried, tested, and trusted. No other large shield generator delivers both exceptional performance and durability to this degree.

6a4d4eb2-dacd-4b04-b17f-e7a02ea7e744.name: FullBlock
6a4d4eb2-dacd-4b04-b17f-e7a02ea7e744.desc: Crafted by former residents of Caliban, Gorgon’s FullBlock large shield generator has been repeatedly put to the test by members of the military and public. That means you can count on it regardless of what you come up against.

2fefe4af-48ca-4044-bb89-11cbdab74bbb.name: SecureScreen
2fefe4af-48ca-4044-bb89-11cbdab74bbb.desc: Gorgon Defender Industries brings military might to their entry-level, large shield generator. Featuring best-in-class durability, the SecureScreen was built to take a beating and survive.

925ec9df-cd0d-4c40-a5ad-6d22bdbfdeaa.name: SureStop
925ec9df-cd0d-4c40-a5ad-6d22bdbfdeaa.desc: Gorgon’s SureStop shield generator was initially developed for military applications, aiming for a middle-of-the-road alternative for circumstances that are anything but. Featuring new Envelop projection technology, the SureStop emphasizes performance and dependability over lower signature.

84f07b24-342d-4956-8928-25832eb4e999.name: Holdstrong
84f07b24-342d-4956-8928-25832eb4e999.desc: This capital-class shield generator was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

dfe6794e-80e7-4d2b-9dbc-6c2f8eb0018c.name: Holdstrong
dfe6794e-80e7-4d2b-9dbc-6c2f8eb0018c.desc: This capital-class shield generator was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

6fc982c0-2747-42b7-a628-7c76ecedf732.name: Glacis
6fc982c0-2747-42b7-a628-7c76ecedf732.desc: Origin turned to the experts at Basilisk to build a bespoke shield generator for the 890 Jump. The Glacis blends centuries of cutting edge innovation to produce a strong and stable shield capable of defending the valuable ship and passengers aboard.

d9870a05-1a66-4a9a-bec6-30eb67e3a3ce.name: Deterrent
d9870a05-1a66-4a9a-bec6-30eb67e3a3ce.desc: This capital-class shield generator was designed specifically for the Polaris.

ffede9a8-3c50-4b9e-be0f-9d93e5a26f29.name: PIN
ffede9a8-3c50-4b9e-be0f-9d93e5a26f29.desc: With the PIN vehicle shield generator you can now trust Seal Corp to protect you whether you’re in space or atmosphere.

2de33b34-afaf-40ec-ab30-0a5039946866.name: HEX
2de33b34-afaf-40ec-ab30-0a5039946866.desc: Prepare your ship for any circumstance by installing a HEX from Seal Corporation. Balanced performance and durability make this an ideal, versatile choice for those who don’t know where their next adventure may take them.

4323ef0d-778f-4e8f-89e8-bbe3d33f5f08.name: INK
4323ef0d-778f-4e8f-89e8-bbe3d33f5f08.desc: When you’re looking for a dependable shield, why not trust the company that’s been doing it longer than anyone else? Seal Corporation’s original INK shield generator has been a staple around the Empire for generations.

6be9c02c-ff32-483f-a6f8-d984dcb97c40.name: WEB
6be9c02c-ff32-483f-a6f8-d984dcb97c40.desc: Tried, tested, and refined for centuries, the WEB shield generator balances sleek design with stellar performance to keep your ship safe under a wide variety of circumstances.

cd1ed528-ce0f-4aaa-8ae3-370c48f97d9f.name: BLOC
cd1ed528-ce0f-4aaa-8ae3-370c48f97d9f.desc: Seal Corporation’s BLOC shield generator was the first to use the company’s revolutionary quantum core semiconductor to reduce the component’s power draw without compromising performance.

0d335e5f-94ea-4d27-a608-6024e588e131.name: RPEL
0d335e5f-94ea-4d27-a608-6024e588e131.desc: See why more people trust Seal Corporation to protect their ship than any other company. With the RPEL shield generator you can be certain you’ll be sealed off from danger.

86bfeaef-e0e2-4373-9dca-47e193c0b203.name: STOP
86bfeaef-e0e2-4373-9dca-47e193c0b203.desc: Utilizing a design that has proven itself time and again, the STOP shield generator by Seal Corporation has featured the same classic design for years due to its consistent, stellar performance.

324e5ee4-12b4-4f41-bccc-b3b001398a74.name: ARMOR
324e5ee4-12b4-4f41-bccc-b3b001398a74.desc: ARMOR is Seal Corps’ top-of-the-line shield generator. It was used extensively by the military prior to its shield tech being declassified for civilian use.

87710dba-dd06-41b4-974e-475ee7d36055.name: GUARD
87710dba-dd06-41b4-974e-475ee7d36055.desc: Don’t be afraid to go up against the unknown with Seal Corp’s GUARD. This shield generator balances performance, durability, and stealth to allow the user to utilize the shield in whatever way suits them best.

aebbc33c-5a32-43c7-8646-f3373466c68f.name: HAVEN
aebbc33c-5a32-43c7-8646-f3373466c68f.desc: The HAVEN is an admired shield generator for large ships. Seal Corp’s simple, clean design makes repairing the component an easy and affordable task, and has only increased its popularity over the years.

b64ab3f3-4b44-418c-a438-57a04a1cf1b2.name: Falco
b64ab3f3-4b44-418c-a438-57a04a1cf1b2.desc: Falco is the perfect shield generator for those always on the go. Its lightweight build won’t hurt your top speed, while still being able to absorb enough damage for you to make your escape.

0eae2a8c-8bc9-4b32-af70-a06e667b0165.name: Jaghte
0eae2a8c-8bc9-4b32-af70-a06e667b0165.desc: Built with performance in mind, Yorm’s Jaghte competition shield generator prioritizes shield health and generation rate over strength and stealth.

d0669062-2e64-41d4-beb2-d510588ca593.name: Targa
d0669062-2e64-41d4-beb2-d510588ca593.desc: Based on Gotlieb Yorm’s original design, the Targa is a light, high performance, competition-grade generator that revolutionized racing.

e2dc5036-24ea-4b85-ab00-34c179ac2e04.name: Bamoty
e2dc5036-24ea-4b85-ab00-34c179ac2e04.desc: The Bamoty is Yorm’s take on a commercial style shield generator. This medium-sized component has won the company a wider fanbase because it expertly balances performance, durability, and stealth.

78f47f2b-6680-4b08-a50a-e0b902ad4d9e.name: Haltur
78f47f2b-6680-4b08-a50a-e0b902ad4d9e.desc: Strong shield health and an exceptional generation rate gives the Haltur the best performance ranking of any shield in its class. Beloved by racers and those who prefer to navigate away from danger instead of soaking it up.

33c31f29-03e7-4a23-a26c-5d625d48c1bc.name: Trenta
33c31f29-03e7-4a23-a26c-5d625d48c1bc.desc: An ideal choice for racers looking for a shield generator that provides above average shield performance and durability. As a bonus, the Trenta’s casing is constructed out of a magnesium infused alloy which makes the component both sturdy yet lightweight.

c7c3faeb-1d23-410d-9f75-8b36fd0d58ba.name: LumaCore
c7c3faeb-1d23-410d-9f75-8b36fd0d58ba.desc: Among small power plants, ACOM’s LumaCore consistently ranks among the best for its power rate, cool rate, and high overheat temperature. That’s why if you value your ship’s performance over anything else, this competition-grade component is perfect for you.

41a56edf-ce69-4638-9c80-1692c3d345c6.name: StarHeart
41a56edf-ce69-4638-9c80-1692c3d345c6.desc: Four generations of racing knowledge and know-how are behind ACOM’s StarHeart power plant. Known for its rapid power distribution, the StarHeart has become a favorite among speedsters.

8e828c4f-b435-4db5-aab4-318dead98403.name: SunFlare
8e828c4f-b435-4db5-aab4-318dead98403.desc: Harness the power of a star with this high performance power plant from ACOM. Ideal for racers and those who seek speed.

78e0c040-6668-4b43-a29c-4c47051bba8d.name: LuxCore
78e0c040-6668-4b43-a29c-4c47051bba8d.desc: Famous for performance that laps the competition, the LuxCore provides all the speed your ship needs. You'll leave other medium power plants in the dust with this first-class component from the racing experts at ACOM.

bec88ea5-1dc1-4c87-836c-e9b9026369be.name: SolarFlare
bec88ea5-1dc1-4c87-836c-e9b9026369be.desc: The ACOM team took their years of experience in the racing world and applied it to their component designs. That focus has helped make the SolarFlare a popular power plant among pilots that want to prioritize performance.

1fc13db3-38bd-40b4-aada-3d4d665d1679.name: StarBurn
1fc13db3-38bd-40b4-aada-3d4d665d1679.desc: The StarBurn power plant is another excellent addition to the ACOM line of components. This medium-sized component delivers solid performance without overheating, so you won't risk burning your hands while making important repairs on the fly.

913a1e91-896a-483f-a5e0-34865d4ceee1.name: Charger
913a1e91-896a-483f-a5e0-34865d4ceee1.desc: The Aegis Charger has powered military fighters for generations. Tried and tested in the most demanding of situations, the Charger can handle sudden or sustained power draws with ease.

50e95028-4764-416c-9380-7d9d52d8d82b.name: Fierell Cascade
50e95028-4764-416c-9380-7d9d52d8d82b.desc: Rely on Aegis’ expertise to power your ship. The Fierell Cascade is a military-grade power plant that prioritizes performance over everything else.

d89b535f-8187-4840-b5f4-3230c789dfd1.name: QuadraCell
d89b535f-8187-4840-b5f4-3230c789dfd1.desc: Few military-grade power plants get better than the Aegis QuadraCell. It wasn’t just built to survive the heat of battle, it was built to thrive in it.

688aab9c-bc62-4774-be7d-065dee7e2187.name: Regulus
688aab9c-bc62-4774-be7d-065dee7e2187.desc: The Regulus is the power plant you can count on when everyone is counting on you. Made to exceed exacting military standards, Aegis’ design team has made sure that you have the extra power you need, when you need it most.

22ca3ca2-1bdc-48a7-8689-a0f8259a5441.name: Bolide
22ca3ca2-1bdc-48a7-8689-a0f8259a5441.desc: The Bolide power plant from Aegis has logged innumerable hours of flight experience and is frequently used by the UEE Navy and security forces across the Empire.

662e4a88-d893-46fd-9fcc-e33e4b783fae.name: Maelstrom
662e4a88-d893-46fd-9fcc-e33e4b783fae.desc: This military-grade component has been put through the paces by the UEE Navy, so you know the Maelstrom can handle the havoc of battle.

18d542ac-ee74-411e-ad3e-e2e0b980c103.name: QuadraCell MT
18d542ac-ee74-411e-ad3e-e2e0b980c103.desc: An Aegis intern crafted the initial design for the QuadraCell MT power plant, inspiring a phrase often heard around their office, “Fresh eyes bring fresh innovation.” This military-grade component still outperforms any other medium power plant they make.

75d69d04-429b-47e1-b439-4d8e9e4e6bce.name: Vortex
75d69d04-429b-47e1-b439-4d8e9e4e6bce.desc: Turn the tide of battle with the Aegis Vortex. Counted on by the UEE Navy, this power plant can be found on ships defending every corner of the universe.

5db93be6-1fa1-450f-b539-fedf8690cab2.name: Centurion
5db93be6-1fa1-450f-b539-fedf8690cab2.desc: The Centurion stands ready to power your ship. This large power plant from Aegis Dynamics has been in service for centuries and has consistently proven to supply solid performance and durability.

50643ac7-c238-4d7a-987b-fd8b1648ac1b.name: Drassik
50643ac7-c238-4d7a-987b-fd8b1648ac1b.desc: The Drassik is a military-grade power plant from Aegis Dynamics. The large component is known for providing decent durability but unremarkable performance.

4364d2ea-3516-474b-8f45-ae146c120ee7.name: Fulgur
4364d2ea-3516-474b-8f45-ae146c120ee7.desc: Tried and tested by the UEE Navy on the Vanduul front, the Fulgur large power plant from Aegis Dynamics is now available for all to put to use protecting what’s important.

ecea4817-3a40-480d-918d-6fe8cf7227c2.name: QuadraCell MX
ecea4817-3a40-480d-918d-6fe8cf7227c2.desc: Aegis engineers set out to create a power plant that could deliver the performance and durability needed during prolonged engagements. The QuadraCell MX was the result. This large power plant received years of strenuous field testing before finally becoming available to the public.

0b758584-4cc6-4306-85dd-07e1b81d6852.name: DynaFlux
0b758584-4cc6-4306-85dd-07e1b81d6852.desc: The DynaFlux was one of the first components A&R Co. built when they expanded their product line to more than energy weapons. Their years of experience manufacturing military-grade equipment went a long way to making the DynaFlux power plant a standout right from the beginning.

f0510922-1ae3-4b30-936b-a8ac7b7fd048.name: HyperGen
f0510922-1ae3-4b30-936b-a8ac7b7fd048.desc: The HyperGen power plant is popular among both civilians and the military for its high quality. As a bonus, the manufacture, Amon & Reese, is famous for its stellar customer service.

b1c89d89-d408-4998-9b17-76986d78a9dd.name: JS-300
b1c89d89-d408-4998-9b17-76986d78a9dd.desc: This high-end, military-grade component from A&R delivers excellent performance and solid durability at the expense of slightly increased emission levels. However with the JS-300 pedigree, it’s easy to see why this small power plant has many fans in the military.

13880fbe-7295-4f55-886d-251ad01e2677.name: OverDrive
13880fbe-7295-4f55-886d-251ad01e2677.desc: Amon & Reese knows from years of experience just how hard the military can push their ships. Their OverDrive power plant was designed from the ground up to not only handle those tough conditions with less overheating, but to provide the same dependability and power to civilians as well.

d49cced4-ee82-4a98-8690-93ac432c891a.name: ExoGen
d49cced4-ee82-4a98-8690-93ac432c891a.desc: Simple and direct, the ExoGen generates power in traditional A&R style: no fuss, just solid craftsmanship.

f1763688-a3b6-496e-8d62-3e40e2098661.name: JS-400
f1763688-a3b6-496e-8d62-3e40e2098661.desc: As the UEE’s oldest energy weapon manufacturer, A&R expanded into power plants to interface more efficiently with their weapons. The JS-400 was their first attempt at a medium power plant, and it’s a testament to the quality of this military-grade component that it’s still around.

5df9fe17-bda5-433d-a2cd-bff6b29eeac9.name: TurboDrive
5df9fe17-bda5-433d-a2cd-bff6b29eeac9.desc: The TurboDrive is a common military-grade power plant from A&R that slightly favors performance over durability and stealth.

f549b612-0be0-41fe-91d1-12a479af2ac8.name: UltraFlux
f549b612-0be0-41fe-91d1-12a479af2ac8.desc: Initially designed under a military contract, A&R's UltraFlux medium power plant decimated the required performance milestones and enjoyed a storied career as a dependable military asset. When the military’s exclusive rights to this high quality component lapsed, A&R eagerly released this to the commercial market.

53e75236-5a91-4d75-8c23-373e44daa69c.name: JS-500
53e75236-5a91-4d75-8c23-373e44daa69c.desc: The JS-500 is A&R’s best performing large power plant. This military-grade component receives consistent praise from users both in the military and civilian market.

5fac1c59-a35b-468b-805c-cc273faa02bb.name: MegaFlux
5fac1c59-a35b-468b-805c-cc273faa02bb.desc: Repeated requests from military veterans to make the MegaFlux commercially available convinced A&R Co. to release this large power plant to the public.

39e271e4-e9f4-421d-9673-063726b72c8b.name: SmartGen
39e271e4-e9f4-421d-9673-063726b72c8b.desc: The no-frills SmartGen is A&R’s entry-level large power plant that delivers solid performance for the price.

202db33c-6b87-4210-9392-6d5368bc3436.name: SuperDrive
202db33c-6b87-4210-9392-6d5368bc3436.desc: A&R’s award winning customer service sets the SuperDrive apart from other military power plants in its class. Consumers love that they can depend on both the component and company when the going gets tough.

ad59f651-83d0-42f3-839a-8f055243ba6b.name: Defiant
ad59f651-83d0-42f3-839a-8f055243ba6b.desc: In this cutthroat universe, the competition doesn’t stop when you do. That’s why you need the Defiant industrial power plant equipped in your vehicle. It’s optimized by the experts at Juno Starwerk to provide unmatched performance compared to other components in its class.

926ea000-c084-4461-bfd1-bbab1c1138a9.name: Jennet
926ea000-c084-4461-bfd1-bbab1c1138a9.desc: Juno Starwerk’s foray into vehicle power plants begins with the Jennet. While not as highly-rated as similar components, the company’s reputation for dependability and ease of maintenance still make it a favorite in some circles.

0ed88703-3183-48c8-95f1-eda2b5b4381a.name: Steadfast
0ed88703-3183-48c8-95f1-eda2b5b4381a.desc: When the road ahead is long, Juno Starwerk’s Steadfast power plant is there to see you and your vehicle through to the end by providing on-demand power and durability.

e533d75c-9275-48e9-bc93-f49a2c113bc5.name: Breton
e533d75c-9275-48e9-bc93-f49a2c113bc5.desc: The Breton embodies exactly what Juno Starwerk engineers wanted out of an industrial power plant — utilitarian, easy to repair and extremely powerful. You’ll be hard pressed to find a better balance of performance and durability from a unit this size.

49d355d9-b5a5-454a-a6e8-dedb4bdffa02.name: Endurance
49d355d9-b5a5-454a-a6e8-dedb4bdffa02.desc: Juno Starwerk’s Endurance has been in service since the 26th century. This industrial strength, utilitarian power plant is a favorite of mechanics since spare parts are easily acquired.

a1108d40-080d-4087-b5e2-5030336ee180.name: Fortitude
a1108d40-080d-4087-b5e2-5030336ee180.desc: Beloved by haulers for centuries, the Fortitude lives up to its name by reliably producing power when needed most.

9a5c71d4-12c0-4994-a41f-98b6e6018151.name: Roughneck
9a5c71d4-12c0-4994-a41f-98b6e6018151.desc: For its class, the Roughneck power plant from Juno Starwerk is an ideal component for haulers looking for maximum performance.

be3eb52b-243a-4ed9-833a-d348f910a32a.name: Diligence
be3eb52b-243a-4ed9-833a-d348f910a32a.desc: Though the Diligence delivers high performance compared to other components in its class, this power plant’s dependability and ease of maintenance is what makes it a favorite of haulers.

2a02027b-5c19-456b-901b-663189505be0.name: Genoa
2a02027b-5c19-456b-901b-663189505be0.desc: According to Juno Starwerk, good industrial design is meant to go unnoticed, yet it’s hard not to marvel at the Genoa medium power plant, as its outstanding performance and noted durability make it a first-rate component.

bd423b9c-4115-4785-909a-77d621fd2bc4.name: Sedulity
bd423b9c-4115-4785-909a-77d621fd2bc4.desc: When you need a power plant that’s as reliable as you are, then snag yourself a Sedulity. This component has been a staple of the Juno Starwerk line for years, making it truly worthy of the name.

aa15e2df-d7b1-4e97-9e0d-7623a3a096b0.name: Trommel
aa15e2df-d7b1-4e97-9e0d-7623a3a096b0.desc: Utilitarian to its core, the Trommel’s lack of frills has made the power plant a favorite of mechanics around the Empire.

090ad136-ea1a-4381-a21b-fdfbc85ed273.name: Durango
090ad136-ea1a-4381-a21b-fdfbc85ed273.desc: The Durango is the peak of large power plants produced by Juno Starwerk. This top-of-the-line industrial component provides unmatched energy dispersion that minimizes fluctuations and surges during heavy demand.

96244ab6-8819-47c3-87af-78124661c725.name: Ginzel
96244ab6-8819-47c3-87af-78124661c725.desc: The unique name for this stalwart industrial power plant was inspired by the nickname of a Juno Starwerk junior engineer who helped design it.

122c86dc-9d78-445d-9ebe-d2194ab94d4c.name: Reliance
122c86dc-9d78-445d-9ebe-d2194ab94d4c.desc: Haulers have been a fan of the Reliance power plant for years. The component’s clean design and Juno Starwerk’s lauded customer support have made this power plant a fixture on ships around the Empire.

63a0ae66-9852-456e-90a0-1c83e3653efd.name: DuraJet
