63a0ae66-9852-456e-90a0-1c83e3653efd.desc: The DuraJet is Lightning Power Ltd.’s base vehicle power plant. Not only does its design catch the eye, but its reliable construction and affordable price point make it a prime option to keep power flowing through your vehicle.

f27e87f6-5075-470f-83f3-358424a14e7c.name: IonWave
f27e87f6-5075-470f-83f3-358424a14e7c.desc: The IonWave vehicle power plant can help you confidently summit the heights of most peaks without overheating thanks to the incredible technology inside designed by the folks at Lightning Power Ltd.

c46f3fb8-12f8-4c85-b4ac-0850b1e0d17d.name: Radix
c46f3fb8-12f8-4c85-b4ac-0850b1e0d17d.desc: With more than enough get up and go to handle your vehicle’s daily energy needs, the Radix from Lightning Power Ltd. is a power plant you can count on to get you where you’re going.

e5ce3ff8-e9a6-4f5c-872f-edf082422d39.name: IonBurst
e5ce3ff8-e9a6-4f5c-872f-edf082422d39.desc: The IonBurst is touted by Lightning Power as being a best-in-class power plant, providing unequaled performance for the price.

4a4a2a9c-040f-4f36-befe-7101b230fa53.name: PowerBolt
4a4a2a9c-040f-4f36-befe-7101b230fa53.desc: The PowerBolt provides all the power and performance you need for your journey through the stars. You can trust Lightning Power to get you there.

cebbf547-717e-478e-8d52-81f786477295.name: ZapJet
cebbf547-717e-478e-8d52-81f786477295.desc: The Lightning Power ZapJet is an ideal streamlined package perfect for anybody who wants a straightforward no-fuss power solution.

dabd2d8d-c06c-4ebf-8791-192ace67ac33.name: FullForce
dabd2d8d-c06c-4ebf-8791-192ace67ac33.desc: This power plant from Lightning Power Ltd. delivers balanced performance, durability and emissions, providing consumers with a “FullForce” of options as to how to use it.

4f9781e1-cd4d-4f39-b9ad-306ba1704439.name: IonSurge
4f9781e1-cd4d-4f39-b9ad-306ba1704439.desc: Lightning Power Ltd.’s line of medium power plants reach their pinnacle with the IonSurge. Design innovation and higher quality materials push this component's performance higher than others in its class.

c245b408-006d-4b3a-8dc9-0dc5b26b672a.name: SparkJet
c245b408-006d-4b3a-8dc9-0dc5b26b672a.desc: The SparkJet is a basic power plant from Lighting Power Ltd. that strives to balance heat and EM emissions with overall performance and durability.

1dee7b69-d26e-4c02-98cd-f2f5d129134a.name: FullForce Pro
1dee7b69-d26e-4c02-98cd-f2f5d129134a.desc: Even though Lightning Power Ltd has updated the look of the FullForce Pro power plant, it still delivers that same balanced performance people have come to expect.

ae0a922e-7cd6-4bd2-9da0-23c0f575a3af.name: IonSurge Pro
ae0a922e-7cd6-4bd2-9da0-23c0f575a3af.desc: Power plants from Lightning Power Ltd. don’t get much bigger or better than the IonSurge Pro. This top-of-the-line large power plant focuses on delivering solid results to keep your ship working longer.

18fb77da-25b5-4599-98a3-6a6335fe3bc5.name: SparkJet Pro
18fb77da-25b5-4599-98a3-6a6335fe3bc5.desc: Looking to upgrade your power plant on a budget? Lightning Power Ltd's SparkJet Pro gives you reliability across the board, making it a solid choice to get you out and flying.

70019264-f2b2-4741-b50f-bdce41cf0825.name: Stellate
70019264-f2b2-4741-b50f-bdce41cf0825.desc: Sakura Sun worked with Origin to fine tune the Stellate into the perfect power plant for the 890 Jump, providing the power and performance necessary for a ship of such grand design.

796642bf-92fa-48ee-92aa-bf9ba38487a6.name: Stellate
796642bf-92fa-48ee-92aa-bf9ba38487a6.desc: Sakura Sun worked with Origin to fine tune the Stellate into the perfect power plant for the 890 Jump, providing the power and performance necessary for a ship of such grand design.

3493c2d7-9b7f-43ca-aebb-8019fbcc9ef4.name: Sovereign IP-10
3493c2d7-9b7f-43ca-aebb-8019fbcc9ef4.desc: A military-grade power plant built by experts in the field, the Sovereign is a testament to the enduring legacy of the quality of RSI's components.

297e9974-65ff-45e9-8801-2e710e0eede5.name: Helios IP-10
297e9974-65ff-45e9-8801-2e710e0eede5.desc: Setting a new benchmark for performance, the Helios is a true titan of ship components, providing unparalleled output.

fb8629ce-b1ce-47cf-bfdd-94aaa9bf9aa0.name: Sovereign IP-20
fb8629ce-b1ce-47cf-bfdd-94aaa9bf9aa0.desc: A military-grade power plant built by experts in the field, the Sovereign is a testament to the enduring legacy of the quality of RSI's components.

c764fc13-638e-45ec-a906-8a9503049c72.name: Helios IP-20
c764fc13-638e-45ec-a906-8a9503049c72.desc: Setting a new benchmark for performance, the Helios is a true titan of ship components, providing unparalleled output.

86e578cf-3b09-4b7c-b60f-fb9c33bb4597.name: Sovereign IP-30
86e578cf-3b09-4b7c-b60f-fb9c33bb4597.desc: A military-grade power plant built by experts in the field, the Sovereign is a testament to the enduring legacy of the quality of RSI's components.

f86e3f6c-2c38-47dc-bbcf-93d6201289d1.name: Helios IP-30
f86e3f6c-2c38-47dc-bbcf-93d6201289d1.desc: Setting a new benchmark for performance, the Helios is a true titan of ship components, providing unparalleled output.

a117d541-aa61-49fd-ae53-469b0fdf7ccd.name: LightBlossom
a117d541-aa61-49fd-ae53-469b0fdf7ccd.desc: Featuring stylish design and strong performance, the LightBlossom is a worthy addition to Sakura Sun’s line-up, continuing the reputation the conglomerate has for making everything and making it well.

098603e0-7866-47d3-a4f2-dbc98b653971.name: MagnaBloom
098603e0-7866-47d3-a4f2-dbc98b653971.desc: The MagnaBloom power plant achieves above average performance and durability with minimal excess emissions, making it another exquisitely designed component from Sakura Sun.

a5518651-cd87-490d-98ee-dccba428fdca.name: WhiteRose
a5518651-cd87-490d-98ee-dccba428fdca.desc: Pull incredible performance from the WhiteRose. This small power plant from Sakura Sun shines when generating the kind of power that leaves the other small power plants in its wake.

fda65886-0ccb-4a80-a5ee-528b186d4584.name: DayBreak
fda65886-0ccb-4a80-a5ee-528b186d4584.desc: Sakura Sun knows exactly what you need. The DayBreak is a straightforward power plant that provides parity to its performance, durability, and stealth stats.

313907ec-6ce1-473e-8505-3d3e3209075e.name: Lotus
313907ec-6ce1-473e-8505-3d3e3209075e.desc: When it comes to medium sized, civilian power plants Whitley’s Guide continues to rate the Lotus highly. Few can touch this Sakura Sun component when it comes to both performance and durability.

64844114-2aaa-4292-9326-0e3ac941afd9.name: Radiance
64844114-2aaa-4292-9326-0e3ac941afd9.desc: Considering its extensive and extremely diverse line of products, it’s incredible that Sakura Sun can maintain such quality and consistency. The Radiance power plant is a perfect example. A staple of their product line for years, the Radiance has won multiple consumer awards for its reliability and overall performance.

cfe4539d-2066-4317-8d52-cba38ac3767e.name: Celestial
cfe4539d-2066-4317-8d52-cba38ac3767e.desc: The Celestial from Sakura Sun improves upon the company’s base large power plant by redesigning the power rate and other key aspects to raise the component’s overall performance.

397bd43e-fdbf-45b3-ba56-79647656f23e.name: NewDawn
397bd43e-fdbf-45b3-ba56-79647656f23e.desc: The NewDawn was appropriately named, as it was the first large power plant built by Sakura Sun. Following its commercial success, the company decided to expand and improve upon their line of large power plants.

3e16e23a-c87e-4b50-9d07-8a3c1bee8116.name: TigerLilly
3e16e23a-c87e-4b50-9d07-8a3c1bee8116.desc: The Sakura Sun engineer leading the design for this large power plant named it after his cat, claiming she was the only family member awake when he got home from work every night. The component does its namesake justice by receiving rave reviews for its reliability.

0a713a9d-7e70-4586-87a6-ce08c337a8ea.name: DeltaMax
0a713a9d-7e70-4586-87a6-ce08c337a8ea.desc: Expert engineering made significant breakthroughs possible when designing the DeltaMax, resulting in a stealth signature even lower than originally estimated by the team at Tyler Design and Tech.

92fc134c-4d10-48fb-b439-aec44e36fe4e.name: Slipstream
92fc134c-4d10-48fb-b439-aec44e36fe4e.desc: Tyler Design & Tech uses an expensive alloy on its Slipstream power plant to reduce its overall emissions. This design choice is key to making this small power plant’s detectable signature one of the lowest on the market.

ad089033-7cfc-479f-b7d4-49a93e1e3bd4.name: SonicLite
ad089033-7cfc-479f-b7d4-49a93e1e3bd4.desc: Constructed from the ground up to minimize your heat signature, Tyler Design’s SonicLite power plant has gained a following among pilots who appreciate a subtler approach.

aff1d3cf-2e01-48a1-8ce3-47fbdbeceb16.name: Cirrus
aff1d3cf-2e01-48a1-8ce3-47fbdbeceb16.desc: The Cirrus is for pilots that prioritize stealth above all else. This medium power plant from Tyler Design & Tech intelligently manages its energy distribution flow and performance output to achieve that end.

277e2f9c-d899-442d-a999-23368b3bdb6c.name: Eclipse
277e2f9c-d899-442d-a999-23368b3bdb6c.desc: Competing medium power plants struggle to match the heat and signature reduction of the Eclipse. Tyler Design & Tech’s mastery of stealth tech makes this component a must own by those who prefer to go unnoticed.

7efda460-54a9-4447-b74d-eaa25ea882cb.name: GammaMax
7efda460-54a9-4447-b74d-eaa25ea882cb.desc: A complete overhaul of the materials in the heatsinks dramatically decreased the emission level of the GammaMax. Few medium power plants run as quiet at the same price point of this one from Tyler Design & Tech.

f59a0b33-5bbe-439e-8bd5-111db00b5ff6.name: IcePlunge
f59a0b33-5bbe-439e-8bd5-111db00b5ff6.desc: When you’re pushing your ship to the limit during that frantic last lap, you’ll be glad you have ACOM’s IcePlunge to keep things cool.

34334a56-0045-40e5-b573-5891e8e2dbbf.name: QuikCool
34334a56-0045-40e5-b573-5891e8e2dbbf.desc: The QuikCool provides superior performance over other coolers in its class. This competition grade component from ACOM sacrifices stealth and some durability to be one of the most powerful entry-level coolers around.

d1790ef8-ec9e-4193-887c-e92d0889e326.name: ZeroRush
d1790ef8-ec9e-4193-887c-e92d0889e326.desc: Few things can push your ship to its limits like racing. Going faster and harder generates a lot of excess heat that can take a toll on your system if not properly managed. The ZeroRush cooler from ACOM has what it takes to get you across the finish line.

67b6c401-1017-4c39-93f6-8305c4c67f69.name: AbsoluteZero
67b6c401-1017-4c39-93f6-8305c4c67f69.desc: Originally designed for racers, the AbsoluteZero cooler pushes performance to the limits. This high quality component from ACOM features a new coolant cycling system to keep your ship’s systems cool over everything else.

c5b36e51-f6ea-4823-be8b-f3dd12fbda3c.name: IceDive
c5b36e51-f6ea-4823-be8b-f3dd12fbda3c.desc: The IceDive delivers peak performance over other medium coolers of its grade, though it does come at the cost of generating high IR and EM signatures.

8db577f4-7874-4c0d-950f-1722015b6f5f.name: RapidCool
8db577f4-7874-4c0d-950f-1722015b6f5f.desc: ACOM brings its performance first philosophy to this medium cooler. The RapidCool trades signature strength and durability for better performance.

4ec3037b-4b6f-4837-b00d-cd9b4836a82a.name: Bracer
4ec3037b-4b6f-4837-b00d-cd9b4836a82a.desc: For those looking for a solid, dependable mid-line cooler, you can’t do much better than Aegis’ Bracer. This small-frame cooler system offers solid performance and durability to keep your ship firing on all cylinders.

5748cdbc-5a26-477a-a4ad-b20a593bde59.name: Glacier
5748cdbc-5a26-477a-a4ad-b20a593bde59.desc: Your weapons, your shields, your thrusters. All vital during combat, all generating heat. Enter the Glacier cooler from Aegis Dynamics. A best-in-class heat management system designed to keep you cool as the pressure mounts.

9afd1cd3-ce6b-4b0a-abdd-cd7d479ec360.name: Polar
9afd1cd3-ce6b-4b0a-abdd-cd7d479ec360.desc: Built to the high demands of daily military service, Aegis’ Polar cooler features a reinforced frame for increased durability. You can rest assured that when you drop into the fires of combat, the Polar will keep your ship cool.

30ffee03-ee0a-47c5-9b4c-b24203c148d7.name: Tundra
30ffee03-ee0a-47c5-9b4c-b24203c148d7.desc: Constructed by Aegis with military performance in mind, the Tundra’s reliable performance has made it a standard cooler of the UEE Navy.

e41f4682-381a-453e-802b-521ce84a26b6.name: Arctic
e41f4682-381a-453e-802b-521ce84a26b6.desc: Providing the kind of durability that made Aegis products a mainstay with the military, the Arctic is an economic mil-spec cooler capable of withstanding the rigors of combat without sacrificing performance.

a52245d7-a95e-46d5-a933-32267371e156.name: Avalanche
a52245d7-a95e-46d5-a933-32267371e156.desc: Showcasing the best of mil-spec cooler technology, the Aegis Avalanche thermal management unit has been built from the ground up to endure the demanding needs of the battlefield.

62f0d8cc-ed06-47d6-9522-bd3950faa19d.name: Boreal
62f0d8cc-ed06-47d6-9522-bd3950faa19d.desc: Designed to disperse the heat of battle, Aegis Dynamics’ Boreal cooler is a military standard with the capacity to survive stressful situations.

5e8af166-4930-4fbc-be29-881fc605f067.name: Permafrost
5e8af166-4930-4fbc-be29-881fc605f067.desc: Designed by Aegis to military standards, the Permafrost cooler has proven itself time and again to be more than capable of handling heat processing even while under the strains of combat.

2c93a027-3b9a-4c8b-b5b0-b03676b35e2d.name: Blizzard
2c93a027-3b9a-4c8b-b5b0-b03676b35e2d.desc: Navy mechanics worked with Aegis engineers to ensure the Blizzard met their specific needs. When it reached the commercial market, this top of the line, military-grade cooler became one of Aegis’ top selling components.

7751572b-05ba-4a0c-816e-fdbd6bc68e6b.name: Galinstan
7751572b-05ba-4a0c-816e-fdbd6bc68e6b.desc: The Galinstan is an older model cooler originally developed for the UEE Navy. Its specs won’t knock your socks off but it remains a solid entry level, large cooler.

335e94ef-d8e9-4ac3-8966-655881c1ea14.name: Mercury
335e94ef-d8e9-4ac3-8966-655881c1ea14.desc: In combat situations, even the smallest advantage can lead to big gains. With Aegis’ Mercury cooling system onboard, you’ll be able to push your ship hotter for longer when you need it most.

3a5723b0-17f6-4741-b421-43ed7cb7dd29.name: Tempest
3a5723b0-17f6-4741-b421-43ed7cb7dd29.desc: On the frontlines, you want to know that your ship is going to perform as expected when you need it most. The mil-spec Tempest cooler sees to it that you can operate within safe thermal ratings for longer thanks to advanced manufacturing by Aegis.

45c6aee2-f38c-4d59-88a8-8cbbc395e938.name: Exotherm
45c6aee2-f38c-4d59-88a8-8cbbc395e938.desc: This capital-class cooler was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

115aaff9-c8c5-4b93-bc14-9f22524fe8a8.name: Algid
115aaff9-c8c5-4b93-bc14-9f22524fe8a8.desc: The Reclaimer is a ship renowned for its ability to work long and hard. To help support even the most arduous salvaging projects, Aegis develop the bespoke Algid cooler.

ce9384b7-b7b8-4ac3-9a9f-47d47aaa3de3.name: BriskAir IC-10
ce9384b7-b7b8-4ac3-9a9f-47d47aaa3de3.desc: Built to the high levels of quality associated with RSI, the BriskAir is a high performance cooler that keeps your systems running at optimal temperatures.

be8b5a16-51ed-4d1a-abc2-53aeb137c6cb.name: BriskAir IC-20
be8b5a16-51ed-4d1a-abc2-53aeb137c6cb.desc: Built to the high levels of quality associated with RSI, the BriskAir is a high performance cooler that keeps your systems running at optimal temperatures.

f927a3d6-1c15-4d6f-ae34-5dfcf04a6bd2.name: BriskAir IC-30
f927a3d6-1c15-4d6f-ae34-5dfcf04a6bd2.desc: Built to the high levels of quality associated with RSI, the BriskAir is a high performance cooler that keeps your systems running at optimal temperatures.

7db13b34-c8b1-4e1a-9aba-3dcd7087e995.name: Cryo-Star SL
7db13b34-c8b1-4e1a-9aba-3dcd7087e995.desc: J-Span’s done it again. The Cryo-Star SL incorporates the same consumer award winning performance and durability you’ve come to expect from a Cryo-Star, but now available for smaller vehicles.

387da568-31d2-4479-81da-21dd015db668.name: Frost-Star SL
387da568-31d2-4479-81da-21dd015db668.desc: Whether cruising across the ground or sailing through space, there’s a J-Span cooler perfect for you. The Frost-Star SL is a mid-tier cooler designed to bring the line’s reliability to ground and open-canopy vehicles.

26f6ac67-8c44-4160-8be2-d64d07d3ec3a.name: Winter-Star SL
26f6ac67-8c44-4160-8be2-d64d07d3ec3a.desc: The latest in J-Span’s Winter-Star line of coolers, the SL’s new Kivo system offers a unique dispersal method, allowing your vehicle to manage heat better than ever before.

0a190bad-bbb1-4988-9622-61b7af717d6f.name: Cryo-Star
0a190bad-bbb1-4988-9622-61b7af717d6f.desc: J-Span’s consumer-grade Cryo-Star cooler has become a common sight across the Empire thanks to its reliable heat absorption that won’t strain your ship’s power-plant.

d8059126-352a-4be5-bfc9-15cf4fb05439.name: Frost-Star
d8059126-352a-4be5-bfc9-15cf4fb05439.desc: Noted for its consistent performance, the Frost-Star cooler from J-Span has many admirers for its well-balanced power to heat ratio.

ec636cbd-21c6-4b9c-a095-c8ef04f1a9fa.name: Winter-Star
ec636cbd-21c6-4b9c-a095-c8ef04f1a9fa.desc: Join the J-Span family by snagging the Winter-Star cooler for your ship. This entry-level model lacks flash but its strong performance record and price point make it a popular choice for pilots across the UEE.

b3e803cc-f907-494d-8e35-51703eae4b6f.name: Cryo-Star EX
b3e803cc-f907-494d-8e35-51703eae4b6f.desc: With its EX line, J-Span has brought the same reliable heat absorption of their popular Cryo-Star cooler to pilots looking to outfit larger ships.

59a37716-f4d3-4dcb-a41e-0f2c3064e169.name: Frost-Star EX
59a37716-f4d3-4dcb-a41e-0f2c3064e169.desc: The Frost-Star EX cooler comes to you from J-Span, a manufacturer with a well deserved reputation among ship owners for constructing coolers that can reliably handle heat exchange wherever you may fly.

5800c752-938f-4b6a-b39b-7f770c6fa060.name: Winter-Star EX
5800c752-938f-4b6a-b39b-7f770c6fa060.desc: The Winter-Star EX is a baseline cooler you can trust. Built by the experts at J-Span, it’s ready to handle whatever conditions you encounter.

d36feefd-7377-4188-9271-355709039a39.name: Cryo-Star XL
d36feefd-7377-4188-9271-355709039a39.desc: With its well-crafted design and dependable performance, the Cryo-Star XL cooler proves from the moment you use it that no one understands heat management better than J-Span.

bea66e66-0d30-4f9c-8eaa-b15002fb2299.name: Frost-Star XL
bea66e66-0d30-4f9c-8eaa-b15002fb2299.desc: As your ship flies, components generate heat that can be damaging and even lead to system failures unless properly dealt with by a dependable and properly designed cooler like the Frost-Star XL from J-Span.

71df1f43-b44d-47e7-9d29-2a4e090aee07.name: Winter-Star XL
71df1f43-b44d-47e7-9d29-2a4e090aee07.desc: For two centuries, J-Span has dedicated itself to manufacturing coolers. The Winter-Star XL is their entry level large cooler. What it lacks in features, it more than makes up for in solid craftsmanship.

b2279e37-c5fb-49ab-b008-b32f3c528706.name: Eco-Flow
b2279e37-c5fb-49ab-b008-b32f3c528706.desc: A standard for centuries, Juno Starwerk’s industrial Eco-Flow cooler is a favorite of haulers for being easy to maintain even when carrying the heaviest cargo loads.

a5107834-61e1-481d-b836-7ed6c08b14d5.name: Hydrocel
a5107834-61e1-481d-b836-7ed6c08b14d5.desc: Keep your ship working harder for longer with the durable Hydrocel, an entry-level industrial cooler from respected manufacturer Juno Starwerk.

bba050c3-1348-45a8-91c6-73e4ecf5082f.name: Thermax
bba050c3-1348-45a8-91c6-73e4ecf5082f.desc: Juno Starwerk has done it again. With the Thermax line of coolers, Juno raised the bar on economical industrial coolers made to fit any budget. These small coolers offer above average performance and durability but without breaking the bank.

5ffb1abc-c4ed-4413-b882-ccd848ca09a2.name: Ultra-Flow
5ffb1abc-c4ed-4413-b882-ccd848ca09a2.desc: Juno Starwerk has crafted the Ultra-Flow to not only withstand the demanding cooling needs of your ship’s systems as it works, but to do it longer and better than other coolers in its class.

553f7473-1d24-41b5-bd53-baa4190464d0.name: CoolCore
553f7473-1d24-41b5-bd53-baa4190464d0.desc: The name CoolCore says it all. Designed by Juno Starwerk to be as hardworking as you are, this cooler helps ensure that your entire ship operates well within desired temperature parameters.

866c76c0-8c22-44ad-b1dc-167ee5fbe347.name: HydroJet
866c76c0-8c22-44ad-b1dc-167ee5fbe347.desc: When your ship overheats, it makes just about any task not only more difficult, but potentially dangerous for you and your crew. With the entry-level HydroJet from Juno Starwerk installed, you can be confident that your heat levels are being controlled by a cooler designed by one of the most trustworthy names in the industry.

f0429b13-6f0d-4ffb-9160-6ae0df03b5cb.name: Snowfall
f0429b13-6f0d-4ffb-9160-6ae0df03b5cb.desc: Few things can be as damaging to your ship over time as excess heat build up. The Juno Starwerk Snowfall cooler helps ensure that your ship stays the right temperature for longer, which means that you can keep flying for longer.

04285ce3-561f-4377-b0db-c641e3fad1de.name: Snowpack
04285ce3-561f-4377-b0db-c641e3fad1de.desc: Medium-sized industrial coolers don’t get any better than the Snowpack from Juno Starwerk. Outstanding performance and durability have made it a favorite of haulers for centuries.

98180be7-076c-4621-994a-284d1c17a366.name: Chill-Max
98180be7-076c-4621-994a-284d1c17a366.desc: The Chill-Max name is as straightforward as the design on this Juno Starwerk cooler. This highly-rated industrial cooler has been a favorite of haulers for centuries.

3127738f-d2ba-44bb-913c-eb380182bef8.name: Hydropulse
3127738f-d2ba-44bb-913c-eb380182bef8.desc: An entry level option to Juno Starwerk’s brand of coolers, the Hydropulse sacrifices some durability and utilizes some design tricks to make this large industrial cooler an option for those unable to afford one of their top of the line models.

41ac4e69-f4f8-4efe-b499-0257bdf1aba3.name: Ice-Flush
41ac4e69-f4f8-4efe-b499-0257bdf1aba3.desc: The Juno Starwerk Ice-Flush cooler is built to withstand the heat demands and thermal strains that many industrial ships deal with as part of their average workday.

fd9f41c7-f60b-4ac8-95be-cb501fc5dd5d.name: ThermalCore
fd9f41c7-f60b-4ac8-95be-cb501fc5dd5d.desc: When you’re in the middle of an important job, you don’t want to waste time wondering if your cooler is doing its part. Now you don’t have to. With the dependable mid-level ThermalCore cooler from Juno Starwerk onboard, you can take all the guesswork out of heat management.

d98450a2-605a-47b6-a8cd-f43df14ddf0e.name: ArcticStorm
d98450a2-605a-47b6-a8cd-f43df14ddf0e.desc: If you’re after a cooler that balances performance, durability and stealth, then look to the ArcticStorm. This mid-grade cooler from Lightning Power Ltd uses their centuries old technology to provide performance that can be relied upon.

94ea5bb5-070c-4c75-b90d-66c26c38bb2a.name: BlastChill
94ea5bb5-070c-4c75-b90d-66c26c38bb2a.desc: The BlastChill is a consumer-grade cooler from Lightning Power Ltd. It keeps your ship running without straining its signature, but is best known for a much mocked 2945 ad campaign that promised it was “Built to bring the chill.”

96860a78-4b34-4888-93a5-12efb259a5ff.name: FlashFreeze
96860a78-4b34-4888-93a5-12efb259a5ff.desc: With the FlashFreeze, Lightning Power makes sure that no matter how hot things get, you can rely on its proven cooling technology to keep you flying.

b5543ea6-b332-47d7-a02c-5f25620d2fd1.name: ColdSnap
b5543ea6-b332-47d7-a02c-5f25620d2fd1.desc: Well-balanced performance is the hallmark of the ColdSnap cooler from Lightning Power Ltd., thanks to its ability to easily process the extra heat your ship generates during your day-to-day travels.

572580a2-c164-4f99-beaa-d71cd1bd99a7.name: FullFrost
572580a2-c164-4f99-beaa-d71cd1bd99a7.desc: Proper thermal management and heat distribution is a concern for any pilot who cares about the longevity and performance of their ship. Now you can fly easy knowing you have the advanced FullFrost cooler by Lightning Power aboard.

29026bad-ef1d-4a72-8059-f1fe2c397603.name: WhiteOut
29026bad-ef1d-4a72-8059-f1fe2c397603.desc: Your ship faces a lot of extreme conditions while flying. From the coldness of space to the burning heat of a desert planet, the last thing you want to worry about is if your cooler can keep up. The entry-level WhiteOut from Lightning Power provides thermal management that can help make sure you get where you’re going.

771caf70-effc-49c2-aaf4-c240065db14d.name: ColdSurge
771caf70-effc-49c2-aaf4-c240065db14d.desc: Make no mistake, the ColdSurge may not win any awards, but this large cooler from Lighting Power Ltd provides a good entry-level option for most civilian ships without breaking the bank.

65c269cf-5094-4984-9dbf-d6675a4a785b.name: FrostBite
65c269cf-5094-4984-9dbf-d6675a4a785b.desc: Keep your ship running smoothly with the Lightning Power FrostBite handling your thermal management needs. This consumer-grade cooler can process extra-heat and help maintain optimal running temperatures for all your components.

4f61e805-f5f4-49b2-a834-cfda713f48db.name: FrostBurn
4f61e805-f5f4-49b2-a834-cfda713f48db.desc: Lightning Power Ltd. has put its years of design expertise and manufacturing know-how to craft the FrostBurn, an effective cooler that can handle the large scale heat management needs of a wide variety of ships on the market.

18600693-df8b-4898-a9a6-e91291e69dd4.name: Serac
18600693-df8b-4898-a9a6-e91291e69dd4.desc: Only available for Origin Jumpworks' luxury liner, Wen/Cassel specially designed the Serac cooler to keep the 890 Jump operational through the diverse conditions typically encountered while cruising the stars.

d0b4ce5b-c8ba-4a9f-90b1-c9567a6c90e9.name: Serac
d0b4ce5b-c8ba-4a9f-90b1-c9567a6c90e9.desc: Only available for Origin Jumpworks' luxury liner, Wen/Cassel specially designed the Serac cooler to keep the 890 Jump operational through the diverse conditions typically encountered while cruising the stars.

b4be7e39-8cd9-4d38-af89-61ace9c67796.name: HeatSafe
b4be7e39-8cd9-4d38-af89-61ace9c67796.desc: Pilots looking to keep their IR signature low rely on Tyler Design & Tech. As an entry level cooler, the HeatSafe not only limits emissions, it is built with Tyler’s satisfaction guarantee.

f50cc3fd-dd83-4aec-b74a-270428f22797.name: SnowBlind
f50cc3fd-dd83-4aec-b74a-270428f22797.desc: An IR signature that is running hot is a surefire way to alert the entire sector to your whereabouts and can often potentially prove to be dangerous. With the Tyler Design & Tech Snowblind cooling system onboard you can significantly reduce your heat emissions while keeping your ship running within optimal thermal conditions.

5f474dec-75e8-4626-9c0a-f5a48f841f33.name: VaporBlock
5f474dec-75e8-4626-9c0a-f5a48f841f33.desc: Few coolers can match the stealth performance of the VaporBlock. The team at Tyler Design & Tech have crafted a cooler that keeps your ship’s signature low while delivering acceptable durability and performance.

4df4557d-6c24-421a-9db6-36d731dcffe4.name: HeatSink
4df4557d-6c24-421a-9db6-36d731dcffe4.desc: The HeatSink produces low signatures without sacrificing too much performance or durability, making it a reliable stealth component.

e6ad7280-57d0-4222-942e-6c2a23e78bf6.name: IceBox
e6ad7280-57d0-4222-942e-6c2a23e78bf6.desc: The IceBox is an upgrade to the company’s standard medium cooler, as the team at Tyler Design & Tech made a number of subtle modifications and material upgrades that lowered the component’s signatures without greatly affecting its durability.

acb949b6-488a-4d10-b0f3-6597ef22925e.name: NightFall
acb949b6-488a-4d10-b0f3-6597ef22925e.desc: Run silent and safe with the NightFall from Tyler Design & Tech. Few coolers can match the way this component manages your ship's heat while also keeping its signatures low.

97bf2cfe-efb8-469b-9d43-6e4a88130417.name: Fridan
97bf2cfe-efb8-469b-9d43-6e4a88130417.desc: The Fridan is Wen/Cassel Propulsion’s entry-level vehicle cooler. It has proven time and again that it can withstand even the worst environmental conditions, making it an ideal component for your vehicle.

c9eecfff-8ab2-4cd1-b7f8-1ea6aa86fd5a.name: Kelvid
c9eecfff-8ab2-4cd1-b7f8-1ea6aa86fd5a.desc: The Kelvid is a high performance, rough and tumble cooler system designed to keep your vehicle humming for longer, rather than catching its breath.

9bfb25e0-b507-4d6f-b8e5-d7d2d91f9670.name: Tepilo
9bfb25e0-b507-4d6f-b8e5-d7d2d91f9670.desc: Few can top the cooling power of Wen/Cassel’s Tepilo. This top of the line cooler provides stellar durability and performance for ground vehicles.

f68e5fb2-2388-43d1-9aab-bed82da648c8.name: Berian
f68e5fb2-2388-43d1-9aab-bed82da648c8.desc: The Berian delivers Wen/Cassel’s signature look and performance in an introductory cooler that will meet and surpass pilot’s expectations.

f6ab217a-2506-42ad-b6f2-90bdf939c0af.name: Endo
f6ab217a-2506-42ad-b6f2-90bdf939c0af.desc: A cooler for discerning ship-owners who are looking to push their craft further, Wen/Cassel’s Endo features above average cooling performance and thoughtful design.

5e5e363e-2ae2-455f-8062-49189906fdc9.name: Gelid
5e5e363e-2ae2-455f-8062-49189906fdc9.desc: Allowing for greater thermo-dispersal and improved performance output, the top-of-the-line Gelid cooler from Wen/Cassel is an all-inclusive heat management system ideal for a variety of ships.

308a2992-585b-40ba-9cfb-51251a3e0683.name: Aufeis
308a2992-585b-40ba-9cfb-51251a3e0683.desc: Impeccable design and unmatched attention to detail from Wen/Cassel Propulsion makes the Aufeis one of the premiere civilian coolers on the market.

8d2c7d2d-7359-474b-90cd-c0ba9c31ac7f.name: Graupel
8d2c7d2d-7359-474b-90cd-c0ba9c31ac7f.desc: The Graupel not only provides the top of the line cooling technology that larger ships need to maintain optimal performance, it does it with Wen/Cassel’s signature craftsmanship.

576b939f-1596-42ee-95b4-d5c871542d8c.name: Taiga
576b939f-1596-42ee-95b4-d5c871542d8c.desc: Wen/Cassel has worked long and hard to develop quality coolers like the latest edition Taiga, which can process and manage excess heat while consistently maintaining the high standards that they have become known for.

16dc5148-59f5-497b-a2b1-8f6f66513a8f.name: Draug
16dc5148-59f5-497b-a2b1-8f6f66513a8f.desc: The Draug balances performance, durability, and stealth. Making this large Wen/Cassel cooler ready to respond to any situation you find yourself in.

c0f30e06-78e9-4df9-846a-8ff0716111f5.name: Elsen
c0f30e06-78e9-4df9-846a-8ff0716111f5.desc: Wen/Cassel engineers used many of the same parts found in the Draug, only fine tuned to deliver improved performance and durability without greatly enhancing its signature. That makes the Elsen large cooler a worthy upgrade for those that can handle the extra heat.

3c5a56d9-ff6e-426c-a0dd-6fe0d64037f7.name: Kragen
3c5a56d9-ff6e-426c-a0dd-6fe0d64037f7.desc: When you go big, get nothing but the best. The Kragen from Wen/Cassel Propulsion has consistently been rated among the best large, commercial coolers available on the market.

dadc9318-d0f2-48c2-aad4-f2dd0c5f7fd3.name: FoxFire
dadc9318-d0f2-48c2-aad4-f2dd0c5f7fd3.desc: The FoxFire won't leave a burning trail in your wake, but this quantum drive’s strong performance leaves an equal impression. Making it another elegant and powerful component from the folks at Ace Astrogation.

f3ceefa2-670f-47c5-8c13-a80c8cf93c52.name: LightFire
f3ceefa2-670f-47c5-8c13-a80c8cf93c52.desc: Ace Astrogation built the LightFire for pilots who like to push the edge, but not break the bank. Its focused design provides solid performance at the expense of the component’s durability and stealth.

83ecc7c9-7869-42c9-9b67-c58948a89e58.name: SparkFire
83ecc7c9-7869-42c9-9b67-c58948a89e58.desc: The SparkFire quantum drive from Ace Astrogation delivers fined tuned performance at a reasonable price.

f0790cc0-4ebd-45b9-8419-668635c7f04b.name: SunFire
f0790cc0-4ebd-45b9-8419-668635c7f04b.desc: Great performance and elegant design makes the Ace Astrogation SunFire quantum drive a favorite among race fans and enthusiasts.

4a8d0265-7476-401a-a50f-5780cd212656.name: Burst
4a8d0265-7476-401a-a50f-5780cd212656.desc: With the Burst quantum drive, ArcCorp has taken their popular Rush model and through streamlined re-engineering, managed to improve upon it.

692899e0-b637-40a4-803d-88c43f40d746.name: Flood
692899e0-b637-40a4-803d-88c43f40d746.desc: Experience the true joy of the journey with the Flood. This small quantum drive from ArcCorp has been a staple around the Empire for years.

4e256229-5224-40af-8806-72223f753da2.name: Rush
4e256229-5224-40af-8806-72223f753da2.desc: The Rush is a popular commercial quantum drive that lives up to its name.

da31a82e-30ac-4924-90ad-dc88bc39e7a5.name: Cascade
da31a82e-30ac-4924-90ad-dc88bc39e7a5.desc: The latest medium-sized quantum drive from ArcCorp, the Cascade will confidently carry you to your destination time and time again.

64fb8d1b-50c0-4919-8048-fa813356bbc5.name: Flash
64fb8d1b-50c0-4919-8048-fa813356bbc5.desc: With improved spooling and calibration, the new ArcCorp Flash drive can get you in and out of quantum easier and faster.

d1b9fbc4-797b-4777-a9da-f2e58c095922.name: Torrent
d1b9fbc4-797b-4777-a9da-f2e58c095922.desc: Whatever destination you choose, the ArcCorp Torrent quantum drive is a solid choice to help get you there direct and hassle-free.

85e4dfef-4a24-48ae-8e3f-0998fa1745ab.name: Echo
85e4dfef-4a24-48ae-8e3f-0998fa1745ab.desc: ArcCorp carefully crafted and calibrated the Echo into an affordable yet effective quantum drive.

63fba040-d2ce-40fc-92a4-1541d022e4e3.name: Fissure
63fba040-d2ce-40fc-92a4-1541d022e4e3.desc: Spool up the Fissure and speed through space with the component ArcCorp claims has successfully completed billions of quantum travels over the centuries.

cbcfa21a-a9b8-4932-945a-ad2a93971157.name: Impulse
cbcfa21a-a9b8-4932-945a-ad2a93971157.desc: Legend claims an inaccurate lathe cut materials thinner than expected on the Impulse prototype. When its test performance exceeded expectations, engineers adopted the changes, and ArcCorp's premiere size three quantum drive was born.

e61d58d6-3ffd-4d7b-ad19-64ae9d27efb1.name: Colossus
e61d58d6-3ffd-4d7b-ad19-64ae9d27efb1.desc: Juno Starwerk makes quantum drives that can go the distance and the Colossus is no exception. Though, once you experience its dependable performance for yourself, you might just want to call it exceptional.

fc3fadaa-cd29-4ac5-a2f5-51d4988d3def.name: Goliath
fc3fadaa-cd29-4ac5-a2f5-51d4988d3def.desc: The Goliath was designed to be more durable than other quantum drives in its class. That’s made it a staple of industrial ship since Humanity first started to explore the stars.

ead4350a-695e-4d5d-86c3-e33f99d08217.name: Vulcan
ead4350a-695e-4d5d-86c3-e33f99d08217.desc: Juno Starwerk designed the Vulcan to be both cost efficient and durable. It won’t win any awards for its performance but can be trusted to get you to your destination.

74cc0d0b-1bf5-436c-a38c-1baf93962b89.name: Bolon
74cc0d0b-1bf5-436c-a38c-1baf93962b89.desc: Don’t let lesser craftsmanship put you and your precious cargo at risk. The Bolon industrial quantum drive was built with durability in mind to keep it working when you need it most.

1ed8932d-3d51-4a5d-a323-d696bad07bef.name: Huracan
1ed8932d-3d51-4a5d-a323-d696bad07bef.desc: Juno Starwerk understands that your most important job is to keep your cargo safe. That’s why their Huracan quantum drive prioritizes interdiction shielding, stability, and damage efficiency above everything else.

2f4b842b-6261-402d-ab6d-f49c2770c011.name: Yaluk
2f4b842b-6261-402d-ab6d-f49c2770c011.desc: The bigger the haul, the harder your quantum drive has to work. With Juno Starwerk’s Yaluk onboard, you’ll know that you have a quantum drive that is up to the challenge of getting the job done.

069689b2-0abf-47e6-a584-e20819764711.name: Agni
069689b2-0abf-47e6-a584-e20819764711.desc: Haulers have relied on Juno Starwerk's stellar industrial craftsmanship for centuries. The company constantly updates and improves the design of the Agni quantum drive to ensure it remains a top-of-the-line industrial component.

e2599be8-160c-4d20-87d0-3c080109842d.name: Kama
e2599be8-160c-4d20-87d0-3c080109842d.desc: The Kama from Juno Starwerk has won more “Fan Favorite” reader’s poll from ‘Long Haul Quarterly’ than any other industrial quantum drive in its class.

5d57c71c-7122-4567-86ee-0936091ee182.name: Vesta
5d57c71c-7122-4567-86ee-0936091ee182.desc: Ensure your goods get to where they need to go with the Vesta quantum drive. Juno Starwerk specifically designed the component to handle all the trials and tribulations of the long haul.

70163f66-522d-4161-824e-18eb08299258.name: Allegro
70163f66-522d-4161-824e-18eb08299258.desc: Designed specifically for the 890 Jump, the Allegro quantum drive blends ArcCorp's expertise with Origin's exceptionally high standards, making it the ideal companion for a luxury cruise through the stars.

c933bab5-5eec-42fe-ae83-b2c5ff91502f.name: Drift
c933bab5-5eec-42fe-ae83-b2c5ff91502f.desc: Built to keep heat and signature levels low, the Drift quantum drive from RAMP Corporation helps to minimize emissions generated while spooling.

1f6908a2-80b0-48c1-ad76-d93a6afcbfd7.name: Spectre
1f6908a2-80b0-48c1-ad76-d93a6afcbfd7.desc: The Spectre can't make your ship invisible, but it comes close. Expertly crafted by RAMP, this quantum drive disperses heat and hides IR and EM signatures to make it a great small component for those that want to go unnoticed.

94b56098-d5c0-4796-a502-790cbccf34c6.name: Zephyr
94b56098-d5c0-4796-a502-790cbccf34c6.desc: By minimizing emissions through an advanced reduced outflow filtration process, the RAMP Zephyr quantum drive helps ensure privacy while traveling wherever you go.

d6dac840-51e4-4872-b731-2072f3bcfda9.name: Bolt
d6dac840-51e4-4872-b731-2072f3bcfda9.desc: The RAMP Corporation continues their line of low emission quantum drives with the Bolt. This medium-sized component will blast you from one location to the next while producing a minimal signature.

50a21fb7-c45d-408a-8aa3-4d12e1728811.name: Nova
50a21fb7-c45d-408a-8aa3-4d12e1728811.desc: Don't draw attention to yourself with the Nova, which is RAMP Corporation’s base, medium-sized stealth quantum drive.

9ade5d70-fab6-43d5-9f12-72394fa2d5a0.name: Spicule
9ade5d70-fab6-43d5-9f12-72394fa2d5a0.desc: Here one second and gone the next. That’s what you’ll get with the Spicule quantum drive, which RAMP engineered to keep the component’s emission signature as low as possible.

934ac478-9c87-48d1-8fd3-e5359171983c.name: Atlas
934ac478-9c87-48d1-8fd3-e5359171983c.desc: Though it may seem commonplace today, Humanity’s ability to travel across solar systems at quantum speeds was built upon a foundation of Roberts Space Industries’ technology and craftsmanship. Now, space travel has reached even higher heights thanks to the top-of-class performance of RSI’s Atlas pushing quantum drive technology farther than it’s ever gone.

08a5bfdb-1972-421f-83fe-be03b7ac5222.name: Eos
08a5bfdb-1972-421f-83fe-be03b7ac5222.desc: The Eos quantum drive has been a staple in the RSI product line for centuries. Its original design was so perfectly fine-tuned that it has remained basically unchanged since.

aaf32974-612a-4287-a2ba-98f590b193a1.name: Hyperion
aaf32974-612a-4287-a2ba-98f590b193a1.desc: In honor of the name, the first test flight destination for this popular RSI quantum drive was the similarly named satellite of Saturn.

fcfa0140-7d88-452f-aac4-668cd65c4053.name: Aither
fcfa0140-7d88-452f-aac4-668cd65c4053.desc: Named for an ancient god of light and the heavens, the Aither quantum drive honors its namesake as it ferries people places their ancestors could never imagine. This classic RSI medium-sized component has graced civilian ships for centuries.

3bd1502d-f593-456f-a3a9-14fec5b8c1a5.name: Hemera
3bd1502d-f593-456f-a3a9-14fec5b8c1a5.desc: Designing the Hemera quantum drive has allowed the technicians at Robert Space Industries to push the boundaries of quantum travel technology even further, and allow you to go even farther.

1a7eabcd-1c1f-4641-bf5b-41089a774fb6.name: Khaos
1a7eabcd-1c1f-4641-bf5b-41089a774fb6.desc: RSI's Khaos has been tuned to provide dependable performance with reliable construction. Once you've got this strapped in, you'll appreciate the order this quantum drive brings to the chaos of travel.

27a34dd7-30aa-4eca-ae37-1f87e343e238.name: Erebos
27a34dd7-30aa-4eca-ae37-1f87e343e238.desc: The Erebos exemplifies RSI's commitment to excellence. This high quality quantum drive constantly ranks atop "Best of" lists for both critics and consumers.

8f5a16f2-5a4d-4a7f-b625-94bae1d16506.name: Metis
8f5a16f2-5a4d-4a7f-b625-94bae1d16506.desc: There's no room for error when bending space and time to travel incredible distances. So put your trust in RSI, a company that's delivered quality components to the public since the dawn of space flight.

68e9b393-0b32-457b-901b-bee326c88b00.name: Tyche
68e9b393-0b32-457b-901b-bee326c88b00.desc: The Tyche quantum drive harmoniously balances performance, durability, and stealth to create a well-rounded component capable of adeptly handling a variety of situations.

4702547f-fa0f-4f6c-b2ed-9782ee9f518b.name: Expedition
4702547f-fa0f-4f6c-b2ed-9782ee9f518b.desc: Cruise through space confident that your perfectly balanced Expedition quantum drive from Tarsus will get you exactly where you’re going.

0d1169c1-65e4-4ee0-bb1a-f967ab0f3c45.name: Voyage
0d1169c1-65e4-4ee0-bb1a-f967ab0f3c45.desc: Crafted by passionate people who have been leading the way in space exploration and travel for over six centuries, the Voyage by Tarsus is a quantum drive worthy of your next expedition.

f942fa3b-d450-4c4d-a797-49f1a4685d16.name: Wayfare
f942fa3b-d450-4c4d-a797-49f1a4685d16.desc: Speed through space without breaking the bank. The Warfare is a small quantum drive from Tarsus that was specifically designed to help make space travel affordable for the masses.

16ba45f1-bd70-4b58-96d6-0ef822f59803.name: Odyssey
16ba45f1-bd70-4b58-96d6-0ef822f59803.desc: Adventure amidst the stars awaits with the Odyssey quantum drive. Careful and continued refinement from the Tarsus team has kept this component on the cutting edge for centuries.

e4b7bb25-c233-458b-a2b0-b8534733d6be.name: Quest
e4b7bb25-c233-458b-a2b0-b8534733d6be.desc: Why mess with perfection? Tarsus has been manufacturing the Quest drive for centuries to provide everyone an affordable medium-sized component to carry them on their adventures.

4e2d202e-4336-4afc-bada-fbb20450755f.name: Sojourn
4e2d202e-4336-4afc-bada-fbb20450755f.desc: When you explore a star system, it should be about the experiences, the sights, the memories. The Tarsus Sojourn quantum drive takes all the worry out of quantum travel so that you can focus on what’s important, the journey.

1546dd53-4a3d-4fd7-b1ed-bf207bfc9a9f.name: Drifter
1546dd53-4a3d-4fd7-b1ed-bf207bfc9a9f.desc: Balancing craftsmanship and cost, the Drifter provides renowned Tarsus performance at an affordable price.

23652e98-de0a-4b72-a669-9a094cc7471d.name: Ranger
23652e98-de0a-4b72-a669-9a094cc7471d.desc: Rely on the Ranger to guide you through the stars. The quality and reliability of this classic Tarsus quantum drive has made it a ship staple for centuries.

9e3ee84d-86f3-48f3-a4e0-e26899575c5b.name: Wanderer
9e3ee84d-86f3-48f3-a4e0-e26899575c5b.desc: Tarsus carefully designed and tuned the Wanderer into an all-around solid quantum drive, making it one of the more popular components in their revered line-up.

b5cbef86-f37f-4e05-8aff-e0f61afe166e.name: Beacon
b5cbef86-f37f-4e05-8aff-e0f61afe166e.desc: Wei-Tek has made other mil-spec component manufacturers sit up and take notice with the introduction of the highly praised Beacon quantum drive.

95a43815-970e-4a70-87df-0658c32495d8.name: Siren
95a43815-970e-4a70-87df-0658c32495d8.desc: Recent changes by Wei-Tek to the alloys used in the Siren have improved its performance without sacrificing durability, making it a respectable military-grade quantum drive.

995c2de5-f7e6-4646-83e3-4627ba5a5865.name: VK-00
995c2de5-f7e6-4646-83e3-4627ba5a5865.desc: When the stakes are high, Wei-Tek’s advanced VK-00 quantum drive is the only choice you should trust to get you where you need to be.

9e3a3bcb-d90a-46c5-912b-079fd15157cc.name: Crossfield
9e3a3bcb-d90a-46c5-912b-079fd15157cc.desc: Wei-Tek has marketed the Crossfield specifically to target military personnel and veteran pilots who will appreciate the stats that the mil-spec quantum drive offers.

fce50a6d-690e-4b2d-9104-f3743387e1f0.name: XL-1
fce50a6d-690e-4b2d-9104-f3743387e1f0.desc: Wei-Tek might be a new company, but their line of military-grade components is already gaining notoriety. The XL-1 is their premier medium quantum drive that expertly blends performance and durability.

903b3f33-f3de-412f-8804-19090436c525.name: Yeager
903b3f33-f3de-412f-8804-19090436c525.desc: Whether you’re rushing to the rescue or simply patrolling through a sector, the Yeager quantum drive from Wei-Tek allows for greater performance when you need it most.

a7375ca6-be9c-4155-89fb-c507e866ff03.name: Balandin
a7375ca6-be9c-4155-89fb-c507e866ff03.desc: Wei-Tek built the Balandin with military and security personnel in mind. Following a series of test runs by veterans, engineers accelerated the spool and calibration times while also improving the component's precision and stability.

419bff00-12eb-43f7-b284-f8850519b9c6.name: Pontes
419bff00-12eb-43f7-b284-f8850519b9c6.desc: When placed under stress tests, the proprietary alloys used by Wei-Tek to build the Pontes proved themselves against competitors in the same class.

8ea47c7e-f70f-469d-abc2-911cc5013854.name: TS-2
8ea47c7e-f70f-469d-abc2-911cc5013854.desc: Advanced protective plating provides the TS-2 with superior durability and protection against the elements and aggressors, making it an ideal quantum drive for those moments when danger calls.

02287bd1-e17b-4f73-bca2-0cded92a9423.name: Frontline
02287bd1-e17b-4f73-bca2-0cded92a9423.desc: This capital-class quantum drive was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

5f54cdb1-8397-479f-9b14-8988fc53373e.name: 890 Jump Module
5f54cdb1-8397-479f-9b14-8988fc53373e.desc: This capital-class jump module was designed specifically for the 890 Jump.

c8797bce-6220-4d1e-bc6d-23da4a366a6d.name: Explorer
c8797bce-6220-4d1e-bc6d-23da4a366a6d.desc: Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Explorer jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

14cbe476-4050-4af5-8635-178519722f4b.name: Excelsior
14cbe476-4050-4af5-8635-178519722f4b.desc: Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Excelsior jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

59346c37-671d-4aae-9eff-d38e13caa9c0.name: Exodus
59346c37-671d-4aae-9eff-d38e13caa9c0.desc: Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Exodus jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

af671ad3-d55d-44b3-8617-473bd3dc0da6.name: Exfiltrate
af671ad3-d55d-44b3-8617-473bd3dc0da6.desc: This capital-class jump module was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

dd3a17c3-cfac-49b4-990a-64ac2efa22e1.name: Spark I-G Missile
dd3a17c3-cfac-49b4-990a-64ac2efa22e1.desc: Those that believe size doesn’t matter would do well to stay clear of the Firestorm Kinetics Spark. Using cross section targeting, this lightweight proximity missile packs a considerable punch. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

8c28d7a1-c09c-4718-aa5e-bb23821c04db.name: Pioneer I-G Missile
8c28d7a1-c09c-4718-aa5e-bb23821c04db.desc: Behring prides itself on dependability and the Pioneer is no exception. The updated Oracle EM tracking system has proven itself time and again in numerous consumer-testing reports against similarly classed proximity missiles. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

ff25aeea-8b13-4502-80c5-7f065ab9a313.name: TaskForce I-G Missile
ff25aeea-8b13-4502-80c5-7f065ab9a313.desc: Venturing into the weapons market, Thermyte Concern have pooled their extensive knowledge of demolition explosives to create the TaskForce. A lightweight EM tracking strike missile with a top-in-class propulsion system provides an efficient mixture of speed and firepower to establish battlefield dominance. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

5af848a3-a8e4-487e-8e40-58dc012d97ad.name: Marksman I-G Missile
5af848a3-a8e4-487e-8e40-58dc012d97ad.desc: Behring's Marksman series of proximity missiles has earned as much of a reputation for its ability to track a wide range of heat signatures as it has for its area-effect proximity damage. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

609ef22a-dfa4-4695-93ec-80019ce2242a.name: Tempest II-G Missile
609ef22a-dfa4-4695-93ec-80019ce2242a.desc: The Tempest was designed with nothing but annihilation in mind. Utilizing FireStorm Kinetics' targeting technology, this proximity missile locks onto a target's cross section to draw conflicts to a swift conclusion. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

e768a935-97f7-45fc-9201-79ba2c5802da.name: StrikeForce II-G Missile
e768a935-97f7-45fc-9201-79ba2c5802da.desc: The StrikeForce is the latest culmination of Thermyte Concern's expansion into the missile industry, showcasing notable design and cross-section targeting improvements. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

5bf375c8-d4b8-4bb1-91e7-b6350fea4ad9.name: Dominator II-G Missile
5bf375c8-d4b8-4bb1-91e7-b6350fea4ad9.desc: Designed to track an opponent’s electromagnetic signature, the Dominator strike missile is a precision ordnance package designed to establish tactical battlefield dominance. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

7e12039d-f782-4d14-ac78-6a83ce8a0bf1.name: Ignite II-G Missile
7e12039d-f782-4d14-ac78-6a83ce8a0bf1.desc: The Ignite is Firestorm's premier brand of heat-seeking strike missile that is the definition of Fire and Forget. Simply let it fly and enjoy the show. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

ace7d6e1-63d3-484a-a707-a88f240d40e5.name: Argos IX-G Torpedo
ace7d6e1-63d3-484a-a707-a88f240d40e5.desc: The Talon Argos strike torpedo features a classic, straightforward design that relies on exacting manufacturing standards and a classic cross section targeting system. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

074f4cd7-67f3-4c33-83d9-45050205cfe0.name: Thunderbolt III-G Missile
074f4cd7-67f3-4c33-83d9-45050205cfe0.desc: Thanks to the Firestorm Thunderbolt's agile frame and EM targeting system, this proximity missile is a solid choice for a wide variety of combat scenarios. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

69c9701d-53e2-4377-ac94-f65edfe4c63f.name: Viper III-G Missile
69c9701d-53e2-4377-ac94-f65edfe4c63f.desc: Nova has worked hard to insure that their infrared tracking Viper strike missile lives up to its name by delivering agile and lethal attacks against hostile targets. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

8814fe40-39c1-43c0-8ad4-5bad1c2a2c5c.name: Assailant IV-G Missile
8814fe40-39c1-43c0-8ad4-5bad1c2a2c5c.desc: The Assailant missile from Talon is a perfect weapon solution for precision strikes against motivated opponents. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

4359f338-ee1c-47e3-8607-1613bb35dac5.name: Pathfinder IV-G Missile
4359f338-ee1c-47e3-8607-1613bb35dac5.desc: The Pathfinder proximity missile has been a consistent member of Behring's already robust arsenal thanks to its tried and tested propulsion system and heat seeking guidance array. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

1928b138-e521-4cec-8791-183f6c6c93ec.name: Stalker V-G Missile
1928b138-e521-4cec-8791-183f6c6c93ec.desc: With dedicated cross section tracking, the Talon Stalker has endured over the years as a precision strike torpedo with maximum stopping power. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

a5ea02e9-fb08-498e-9598-55224dfa4b9c.name: Reaper V-G Missile
a5ea02e9-fb08-498e-9598-55224dfa4b9c.desc: The Reaper strike torpedo features a favorable destructive yield-to-expense ratio and a proven Talon EM tracking suite. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

e191151d-bb78-401d-8a3d-7b3406155245.name: Scimitar V-G Missile
e191151d-bb78-401d-8a3d-7b3406155245.desc: The Scimitar missile tracks targets via their EM signature to deliver a devastating size five payload. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

c87e69f1-f860-431f-8739-78f938ce4be0.name: Valkyrie V-G Missile
c87e69f1-f860-431f-8739-78f938ce4be0.desc: Talon's torpedo design team pulled out all the stops for their latest Valkyrie strike torpedo by creating a multitiered thrust solution with state of the art infrared tracking capabilities. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

8cad8989-85f5-4a86-b074-9cbc516afb44.name: Hellion VII-G Missile
8cad8989-85f5-4a86-b074-9cbc516afb44.desc: Carrying a sizable payload and an advanced heat-seeking sensor suite, the Hellion missile from Talon can be effective against aggressors of all sizes. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

e7676087-425d-453e-932c-aaae73932dfd.name: Argos IX-G Torpedo
e7676087-425d-453e-932c-aaae73932dfd.desc: The Talon Argos strike torpedo features a classic, straightforward design that relies on exacting manufacturing standards and a classic cross section targeting system. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

d2cd6b43-5787-41a2-a581-4817b7155b22.name: Seeker IX-G Torpedo
d2cd6b43-5787-41a2-a581-4817b7155b22.desc: Talon's Seeker torpedo is a precision, EM-targeting torpedo capable of delivering a massive payload quickly and accurately. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

61c18fe9-bd26-4a92-a764-823746fb98c1.name: Typhoon IX-G Torpedo
61c18fe9-bd26-4a92-a764-823746fb98c1.desc: Designed by Talon, the Typhoon heat seeking strike torpedo delivers a heavy payload sure to serve as a deterrent from any further hostile actions. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

b86bd2f2-1f5e-4731-a286-74faa8cde646.name: Spark I Missile
b86bd2f2-1f5e-4731-a286-74faa8cde646.desc: Those that believe size doesn’t matter would do well to stay clear of the Firestorm Kinetics Spark. Using cross section targeting, this lightweight proximity missile packs a considerable punch.

1fcc8a40-af4a-4446-8a7a-354d9244b5d1.name: Pioneer I Missile
1fcc8a40-af4a-4446-8a7a-354d9244b5d1.desc: Behring prides itself on dependability and the Pioneer is no exception. The updated Oracle EM tracking system has proven itself time and again in numerous consumer-testing reports against similarly classed proximity missiles.

62567423-2d97-4515-ab39-b90756c3fe54.desc: Aggressors can’t attack what they can’t see, so keep your signature low with the Pelorous stealth radar from Blue Triangle Inc.

e5bccaed-85de-483b-b4b8-dfb62f085b43.name: Surveyor-Go
e5bccaed-85de-483b-b4b8-dfb62f085b43.desc: The SurveyorGo is a vehicle-sized version of Chimera Communications' popular line of radars.

0982203d-579f-4c3c-8b7a-c5f1c4a7ddd6.desc: The Arbor has became the universe's most heralded mining laser thanks to Greycat Industrial's exacting standards and business prowess. 8bfc261a-6c67-4bec-b5b5-71407e086ec9.desc: The Arbor MH1 became the universe's most heralded mining laser thanks to Greycat Industrial's exacting standards and business prowess. The laser found favor among industrial and solo operations for balancing speed and safety while also featuring a special filtration system that reduces the amount of inert material collected. Greycat capitalized on this reputation by securing exclusive contracts that made the Arbor MH1 the standard laser head on most mining ships.

4435898e-a6cc-4f51-ab2a-805d0cf1a44a.name: Arbor MH2 Mining Laser
4435898e-a6cc-4f51-ab2a-805d0cf1a44a.desc: The Arbor MH2 is the size two version of Greycat's heralded Arbor mining laser series. ba94a262-bc0a-4484-9bbd-a4be7a2ec3e7.desc: Greycat classifies the Lancet MH1 as a support laser best utilized when mining with others. While the mining laser's small optimal charge window size means precision is key, the Lancet MH1 excels at reducing the amount of inert materials collected by the extraction laser. For mining crews, it's an ideal support laser to use alongside other lasers.

a133320c-1cd0-4622-99dd-715924d6f928.name: Lifeline Module
a133320c-1cd0-4622-99dd-715924d6f928.desc: The Lifeline makes a miner's work easier by reducing laser instability and lessening resistance within a deposit. Yet, a higher catastrophic charge rate means the process must be carefully managed to avoid an accident.

688d8f8b-b3ca-4f5c-acc5-f71dfaf2f5bd.desc: The Optimum makes mining safer by improving laser stability and dramatically decreasing the catastrophic charge rate. To achieve this increased safety, the module reduces the overall power of the mining laser.

1bb6ee6d-3930-4c03-b6c6-38aad3a4703b.desc: The Stampede uses a state of the art lens to increase mining laser power and reduce potential hazard associated with the deposit shattering. These improvements do come at the expense of a less powerful extraction laser.

46643b07-bb39-4ac1-83e4-d428f0c01a75.desc: Instantly inject energy into a deposit with the Surge. It uses a special configuration of lenses to increase mining laser power and bypass a deposit's resistance. It does require careful management as the module also increases laser instability.

47ba04b0-010b-47cd-9f7d-209e2ec190b9.desc: The Torpid Module is a must for any ambitious miner. 9dd4d8a5-49ab-493f-93cb-0536050cd9b4.name: Trawler Scraper Module
9dd4d8a5-49ab-493f-93cb-0536050cd9b4.desc: Scrape more of a hull in one pass with the Trawler scraper module. While the area of effect is larger than other modules, it is less efficient due to intense heat generating more burn off. Making the Trawler the ideal module to use when a job necessitates speed over efficiency.

98e0e5ac-3a76-4f3f-be2f-7fabf65a8826.name: Abrade Scraper Module
98e0e5ac-3a76-4f3f-be2f-7fabf65a8826.desc: It's easy to see why the Abrade from Greycat Industrial is one of the most used scraper module in the 'verse. Its design delivers both a sizable area of effect and respectable extraction rate, creating a reliable beam that can scrape hulls quickly and efficiently.

089f7dc6-8ff1-415b-832d-7a96b92afdfc.name: Comer Scraper Module
089f7dc6-8ff1-415b-832d-7a96b92afdfc.desc: Made for RSI's Salvation, the Comer scraper module provides a focused work area with an expedited extraction rate to allow for a smooth salvaging experience.

1743f1e2-0558-45f6-bc80-d604daf97123.name: Hart Scraper Module
1743f1e2-0558-45f6-bc80-d604daf97123.desc: Made for RSI's Salvation, the efficient Hart scraper module allows salvagers to work quickly to harvest a claim.

81d7c828-42b2-46e8-b2e3-6798bdc32c23.name: Cinch Scraper Module
81d7c828-42b2-46e8-b2e3-6798bdc32c23.desc: The Cinch is a precision scraper module that produces a small, focused beam perfect for extracting resources from every nook and cranny on a hull. While the beam's relatively small size requires more time to remove Recycled Material Composite (RMC), its excellent extraction rate will make the added effort worth it.

cdcddccb-247c-4fcb-ab5b-915822159c87.name: ReadyGrip Tractor Module
cdcddccb-247c-4fcb-ab5b-915822159c87.desc: The Ready Grip Tractor Module compresses the dependability and power of Greycat’s signature tractor beam technology into a smaller sub-component that can be attached to a salvaging laser head.
